articles.title: OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
articles.content: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/

articles.title_zh: Omni Act: 一个政策,100万个嵌入
articles.content_zh: 控制不同机器人的单一政策,不仅必须把任务知识传递到各个化身之间,而且必须使其行为适应每个机器人的能力. 现有方法通过共享动作表示来推动转移,但这些表示并不一定能够捕捉机器人形态上的差异如何形成操纵策略. 我们引入了Omni Act,一种交叉化的操纵政策,它直接在某个特定场景中的每个机器人的动能上附加条件,以产生出具体化的行为. 这个动能图代表了机器人的联想位置,运动轴,以及与其视觉观测的连通性,使得这个政策能够解释它所表现的与现场的物体和表面的关系. 流相相政策预测出每个节点的相对联合运动,使自由程度和动能配置不同的机器人能够进行控制. 为了了解物理结构如何在规模上塑造行为,我们在程序上设计并过滤出100万个物理上可行的机器人浮出水面;接下来,我们开发出算法,在模拟所有浮出水面时生成机器人轨迹;最后,我们训练出各种模拟操纵任务。 在2000个表征-场景控股评价中,《OmniAct》取得了63.0%的成功,而Pi 0.5的比例为17.8%,最强基线的比例为57.9%;在任务家庭中,GPT-6 Astra的比例为64.7%,而GPT-6 Astra的比例为41.1%。 在之前未见的真实世界机器人上,它取得了近两倍于第二好方法"Molmo Act2"的成功率. 除了任务的成功之外,我们还注意到,《Omni Act》学会了不同的操纵策略,这些策略利用各种能力并适应不同形态的局限性。 项目:https://omniact.github.io/

articles.title: PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
articles.content: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

articles.title_zh: 点X: 由 Querying surface Points 绘制的多维相通性
articles.content_zh: 场景的外观由它的表面每个点的反照度,粗糙度,金属度和正常度决定,由到达它的光线,它的辐射度决定. 从图像中回收出这些内在元素是模棱两可的,每像素预测它们的方法使得同一块地表点在每一个视图中都有不同的分解. 我们引入了PointX,一个简单的向导模型,可以预测每个3D表面点的内在性. 多视图变换器编码了一组未放入的图像,对于任何被询问的表面点,PointX会将点的符号汇集到它出现的视图中,一次地解码出点的内在. 场景的3D重建的每个点,如点云或网点,都因此得到一个单一的预测,通过构造完全一致的跨观点,并且能够实现相容的重放和编辑. 同一模型也通过查询每个像素所看到的点来预测从一幅或多幅图像到每个视图的地图. 这些地图在估计几何和对应物的精确度上同意了各种观点。 点X与现有方法相比明显更一致,同时在准确度方面保持单一图像的竞争力并随着观点的加入而有所改进. 项目网页:https://pointx-paper.github.io/

articles.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
articles.content: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiaCap:联合学习谁在视听对话时说话
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍DiaCap,这是一个用于全面对话字幕的视听LLM,它制作记录稿、时间戳和视频中每句话的发言者的视觉描述。 考虑到话语时间和视听分化紧密结合,DiaCap将任务统一在一个模式中,经过两个互补阶段的培训。 首先,我们用225K编译的剪辑来训练DiaCap, 使用合成的字幕, 其次,我们通过对2.9K人修补的剪辑进行强化学习,利用精细的反馈,直接评价发表时间、演讲者分组和演讲者捆绑,进一步完善模型。 在DiaDem Bench上,我们用语音级别的时间戳和字幕编辑来扩展它,DiaCap与现成的笔录及其端到端的变体DiaCap-E2E都取得了很强的成果. 具体来说,DiaCap在视听分化方面与双子座4Argon同等,同时在时间戳准确性方面明显地优于双子座(76.59对42.76 Time)。 它还对多语种和短片录像保持强烈的分化,并转而回答视听问题。

articles.title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
articles.content: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BioLoom:通过学习科学文章的结构来扩大生物医学视野-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 生物医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)的开发具有对比性图像文本预训功能,其驱动力是规模化到日益庞大和多样化的图像文本数据集. 除了扩大规模之外,从现有数据中学习更丰富的表述可以取得进一步的进展。 我们假设,科学文献的结构本身提供了额外的监督来源:数字、面板、标题以及随附的文章文本将各种模式之间的丰富关系编码。 然而,将这些作为独立的图像文本对对待忽略了它们之间的关系。 为了消除这一局限性,我们将这些结构关系纳入反向图像文本监督。 我们保留准确的图像文本匹配,同时对相关对子引入更弱的正向监督,例如一个面板和一个兄弟姐妹面板的字幕. 为了鼓励更细微的歧视,我们增加同一内容类型的交叉文章负面内容。 我们还利用视觉内容、原始图表标题和提及段落来丰富小组说明。 与这些描述和整体数字对齐的面板与原始标题对齐的Loom52M,该数据集有5 240万个图像文本对,横跨科学图表和生物医学图像。 使用Loom52M,BioLoom(DFN-2B)在来自10个域的43个数据集的67个零发分级任务中实现了56.82%的域-平衡平均精度,而MedPMC-CLIP则为48.77%. 在BioLoom Bench上,BiomedCLIP和MedPMC-CLIP分别实现了63.20%和10.59%的双向平均召回率。 代码、数据集、基准和模型见https://bioloom-clip.github.io/。

articles.title: One Take, Many Cameras: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis for Dialogue Re-Cinematography
articles.content: Creating a dialogue scene typically requires cutting between multiple views (e.g., close-ups, medium shots, and over-the-shoulder shots) of the actors. Yet capturing such coverage is costly and in many settings unavailable. We study dialogue re-cinematography: synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video. Existing video generators can synthesize new shots, but rely on visual cues alone, so when the source video barely shows the lips, the generated lip motion fails to match the speech. Our key observation is that the speech audio is view-invariant: it constrains lip motion in any target view. Building on this insight, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model to generate the new shot from a target frame that specifies the view, a source video that contains the performance, and the speech audio that drives lip motion. In multi-person scenes, however, pretrained audio-visual models drive every visible face with the same speech, causing speech leakage, where silent listeners mouth the speaker's words. We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating, a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces that speak in the target shot. On a cinematic paired-view benchmark spanning diverse viewpoints and framings, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0. Our method also remains robust on in-the-wild scenes, highlighting its potential for film post-production.

articles.title_zh: One Take, 许多相机: 用于对话的相机相片合成
articles.content_zh: 创建对话场景通常需要剪接演员的多处取景(如特写,中镜头,和肩部过镜头). 然而,在很多情况下,获取这种覆盖面是昂贵的,而且无法做到。 我们研究对话的再焚化图:从一个单一的广角对话视频中合成更多的镜头. 已存在的视频生成器可以合成出新的镜头,但仅依靠视觉提示,因此当源视频勉强显示出唇相时,所生成的唇动未能与语音相匹配. 我们的关键观察是,语音音频是视图-变量的:它限制任何目标视图的唇动. 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们改用一个经过预先训练的视听传播模型,从一个指定了视图的目标框,一个包含性能的源视频,以及驱动口语运动的语音音频生成出新镜头. 然而在多人场景中,经过预先训练的视听模型会用同名的演讲来驱动每一个能见度的面相,导致语音渗出,默默地听者会说出演讲者的话来. 因此,我们引入了有发言者意识的音频配乐,这是一个无培训模块,只允许音频驱动目标镜头中说话的面孔。 在一个横跨不同观点和框架的影视配对基准上,我们的方法将认知错误降低了59%,标志性错误降低了56%,与最强基线Wan 3.0相比,语音泄漏下降了97%。 我们的方法在全局的场景上也依然有力,突出了其电影后期制作的潜力.

articles.title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
articles.content: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

articles.title_zh: 校园失落:评估野外视觉-语言模型的空间合理性
articles.content_zh: 健全的空间理性(ESR)对于在现实世界中包含的任务中部署视觉语言模型(VLMs)至关重要,但仍然没有得到充分的评价。 现有基准主要评估静态图像或合成室内环境中的空间推理,在这些环境中语义快捷方式往往足够了,因此很难忠实地评价野外的空间推理能力. 鉴此,我们提出了"校园失落"(Lost on Campus),这是在由3D高斯平板电脑重建的大型现实世界户外3D环境中评价ESR的基准. 我们的基准引入了一个统一的推理-行动评价框架,将诊断性QA用于孤立推理与闭路交互式导航无缝地结合,用于多式联运指令下的主动推理。 为了能够进行精细的诊断,我们评估了幼儿死亡率的六个能力方面:行动地平地、空间展望、衡量意识、目标导向规划、自我空间中心本地化和时空一致性。 广泛的实验表明:(一) 与室内环境相比,现实世界室外环境对空间推理的要求要高得多,因为现有模型的性能不佳;(二) VLM仍然与精细的视觉相通相会相会,空间展望的失败和自我至上中心局部化成为主要瓶颈;(三) 提高多模式互动能力和长期空间推理对于推进所体现智能至关重要。 这些结论突出表明,对企业社会责任的忠实评价要求基准在现实和持续的环境中紧密结合认识、推理和行动。

articles.title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
articles.content: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ROAM-Bench:通过证据核查评估有效的空间情报
articles.content_zh: 健全的空间情报需要特工通过探索和互动来收集信息,然后用它来进行推理和行动. 现有基准没有充分区分正确结果和完成这些任务要求。 我们引入ROAM-Bench来评估这些在机器人运动和相撞限制下的能力. 独立检查使用模拟状态和相机记录来评估结果和任务要求,对几何,覆盖或放置进行更严格的检查. 它包括250项人工验证的任务,分为5个组和27个室内环境,涉及物体和房间的搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和搬迁。 人类评估人员在100个抽样任务中实现了84%的严格任务成功率,每个正确的结果都符合要求的检查。 在7个前沿愿景语言模式中,我们确定了两种互补的失败模式:正确结果与未满足的任务要求,以及尽管通过更严格的检查但结果不正确。 Oracle-input诊断显示,更完整的目标观测和校正反馈可以改善最终空间判断.

articles.title: iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
articles.content: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: iWAM: 世界模式的高效行动预测
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)将政策建立在预先训练的视频生成模型上,其前提是预测一个场景如何演变有助于决定如何行动. 然而,产生出未来的场景对于实时控制来说是昂贵的. 这激发了未来想象力的有效代理,但如何在不牺牲行动预测质量的情况下训练这种代理仍然不清楚. 有效的代理不需要产生高分辨率的框架;它只需要提供足够的信息来区分可能的后期. 这导致了iWAM背后的设计原则:我们不是去宣布整个未来的框架,而能把行动政策建立在单个视频模型评价的中间特征上吗? 我们显示答案是肯定的。 探索流相匹配模型的可逆动态,我们把每次训练的未来倒入相应的潜在噪声矢量. 然而,在这种潜在情况下进行单一的速度评价不一定为行动预测带来信息性特征。 因此,我们学习了双向流图,将后世计算分期摊还,使单一模型评价能够提供有效的调节功能. 推断一下,我们用一个视频背骨前行通道 从前行和条件中抽取一个潜在的噪声矢量。 通过模拟基准和真机器人,iWAM恢复了WAM的通俗化效益,同时大幅降低了其推论成本.

articles.title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
articles.content: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Physicl 相机: 艺术家创建的用于学习感知和行动的 三维数据集
articles.content_zh: Physicl Scens是一个由艺术家创造和整理的高质量数据集,由6 499个三维场景组成,跨越了家庭房间、公共室内和室外空间。 数据集结合了详细的几何,物理材料,以及精心地由物体和部分层次的语义说明所组成的环境,为视觉和有内涵的学习提供了丰富的联合监督. 我们展现出它的价值,作为跨反向渲染、三维重建、场景理解和移动操纵的培训数据。 在这些任务中,用我们的场景培训最先进的方法比其他合成数据集提高了性能。 此外,我们引入了移动操纵基准,评价了进行物理取景的视觉-语言-动作模型,并将这些模型置于各种具有现实布局的3D场景中,并使用我们的部分说明来也给每个物体的取景点打分. 我们的数据集将公开发布,以便利视觉研究和体现的AI.

articles.title: BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation
articles.content: Language models can generate LEGO$^\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.

articles.title_zh: BriConstruction: 自动硬砖大会生成的几何限制解码
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以生成 LEGO$ {} 循环 文本中的R$组件,但其构件中往往含有相撞或无所附属的部件. 通常拒绝并重印无效放置的方法,在不保证有效构建的情况下丢弃已解码的令牌. 我们提出BriConstractin,一种受限制的解码方法,在采样前限制一个预先训练的语言模型的下个托肯概率,引导它向有效的放置. 由于一砖放置的有效性取决于未确定的建构状态,因此无法被编译为固定的语法,必须进行动态检查. 然而,在采样前检查一砖的有效性具有挑战性,因为有效放置的空间组合起来很大,无法详尽列举。 我们的关键思想是通过限制部件如何相接而不是限制哪些部件相接来缩小搜索空间. 具体地说,鉴于模型对目前被放置的部分的预测,以及它想要连接的先前被放置的母体,我们制约了模型对它们如何接合的选择. 这使得我们能使用预计算出几何甲骨文来覆盖部分附件的空间,并有效地过滤出相撞选项. 有了有效的附件候选人,我们把模型的下一份分配偏向于其余有效的候选人。 我们用两个LEGO$ 来评估我们的方法 R$格式和模型: BrickNet,它明确注释连接,以及我们提议的隐性连接LDraw格式(ICLF),它使用数字值来进行投放,并隐含连接. 我们的方法将BrickNet的无相撞建筑从31%提高到91%,将ICLF的无相撞建筑从15%提高到65%,并且两种格式的拒绝取样都超过其解码成本的60%。

articles.title: Read My Lips: Context-aware Lip Reading Using Language and Audio-Visual Models
articles.content: Real-world speech is often partially observable: audio may be missing or corrupted by noise and competing speakers, while the speaker's lips remain visible. Recovering speech requires combining what can be heard, seen, and inferred from context. We introduce RML (Read My Lips), a collaborative method combining a lip reader, a language model, and an audio-visual generative model. The lip reader provides articulation hypotheses, the language model uses context to resolve ambiguous or missing words, and the audio-visual generator reconstructs synchronized speech while preserving speaker identity. Since source reliability varies, RML generates multiple reconstructions and uses the available evidence to favor the most reliable ones. This allows RML to handle missing audio, strong interference, and poor visual evidence without manually defined thresholds. Quantitative and qualitative experiments across these conditions show the benefit of combining visual, acoustic, and linguistic signals.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读我的唇:使用语言和视听模型的上下文感知的唇读取
articles.content_zh: 现实世界的演讲往往有部分可观察性:音频可能会被噪音和相竞的扬声器所缺少或腐蚀,而扬声器的嘴唇则仍然能被看到. 恢复口语需要将可以听到的,看到的,从上下文推断出来的结合起来. 我们引入了RML(Read My Lips),一种结合了读唇器,语言模型,以及视听基因模型的合作方法. 相唇读取器提供发音假说,语言模型使用上下文来解决模棱两可或缺失的单词,而视听生成器则在保留演说者身份的同时重建同步语音. 由于源可靠性各有不同,RML生成了多个重建,并使用现有证据来偏好最可靠的重建. 这使得RML可以在没有手动定义阈值的情况下处理缺失的音频,强干扰,以及不良的视觉证据. 贯穿这些条件的定量和定性实验显示出将视觉、声学和语言信号结合起来的好处。

articles.title: EventDiffusion: Learning Native Event Stream Distribution from Videos
articles.content: Event cameras capture asynchronous brightness changes at high temporal resolution, but scarce recordings constrain data-driven research. Sparse RGB observations cannot uniquely determine intervening events since identical frames may correspond to streams with different activity, polarities, and timing. Existing simulators largely rely on prescribed sensor dynamics and estimated brightness trajectories, whose assumptions limit the diversity and fidelity of plausible event streams. We introduce EventDiffusion, a hierarchical generative framework that directly learns the conditional distribution of native asynchronous event streams from real recordings. EventDiffusion decomposes generation into three probabilistic processes: Event Activity Diffusion (EAD) learns stochastic discrete event counts; Event Spatial Allocation (ESA) distributes these counts to individual pixels while preserving cardinality; and Event Timing Diffusion (ETD) learns continuous asynchronous timestamp distributions. We also introduce CEFS, an event-stream realism metric combining event activity and polarity with multiscale space-time structure and temporal fidelity. Across all datasets, EventDiffusion achieves double the accuracy of SOTA methods and demonstrates robustness across different cameras at any resolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 事件扩散:从视频中学习本土事件流
articles.content_zh: 事件相机在高时间分辨度时捕捉出同步亮度变化,但稀缺的录音会制约由数据驱动的研究. Sparse RGB 观测无法独一地决定干涉事件,因为相同的框架可能与具有不同活性,极性,和时间的流相对应. 现有的模拟器主要依靠规定的传感器动力学和估计亮度轨迹,其假设限制了可信事件流的多样性和忠诚性. 我们引入了EventDifmusion, 一个分层基因框架, 直接学习本地同步事件流的有条件分布 从真实的录音。 事件分解将生成分解为三个概率过程: 事件活动扩散(EAD) 学习有条理的离散事件计数; 事件空间分配(ESA) 将这些计数分给单个像素,同时保留基本性; 事件时间扩散(ETD) 学习连续同步时间戳分布. 我们还介绍了CEFS,这是一个事件流现实主义的衡量标准,将事件活动和极性与多尺度的时空结构和时间忠贞性结合起来。 在所有数据集中,EventDifmation使SOTA方法的精度翻了一番,并在任何分辨率上显示不同相机之间的强性.

articles.title: The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset
articles.content: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. In addition to the dataset, this paper introduces practical guidance for future ADL dataset construction. We conducted a detailed analysis of how ADLs are prioritized across academic research, health survey tools, and clinical trials to identify clinically significant ADLs. Furthermore, we provide our experimental design, data collection and annotation strategies, post-processing pipeline for forming the R-ADL dataset from raw data, and baseline results on standard machine learning architectures. The R-ADL dataset serves as a valuable resource for advancing ADL recognition systems as we continue building larger and more diverse datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 日常生活的雷达活动(R-ADL)数据集
articles.content_zh: 日活监测活动(ADLs)支持住在家里的人,特别是老年人的安全和福祉,雷达感知在活动领域越来越得到重视,因为它能够确保家中的隐私,同时也超越了其他感知方式的技术限制。 然而,由于大规模数据集有限,雷达活动识别仍然受到限制。 我们介绍了基于雷达的日常生活活动数据集,以弥补现有工作中发现的差距: 1) 它通过提供8个多小时的有注释的录音来扩大现有数据的规模,其中一人可以进行8个不同的活动;2)它通过从5个不同地点在2个卧室,2个洗手间公寓中进行录音来克服房间配置限制;3)它超越了原始行动,侧重于高级ADLs. 除数据集外,本文还引入了未来ADL数据集构建实用指南. 我们详细分析了如何在学术研究、健康调查工具和临床试验中优先使用抗反转录素,以确定临床上重要的抗反转录素。 此外,我们还提供我们的实验设计、数据收集和注释战略、从原始数据形成R-ADL数据集的处理后程序以及标准机器学习结构的基线结果。 在我们继续建设更大和更多样化的数据集时,R-ADL数据集是推进ADL识别系统的宝贵资源.

articles.title: SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior
articles.content: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

articles.title_zh: SUPRA:从核磁共振和等离子生物标记中合成Amyloid PET,并配有明确的区域SUVR Perfer
articles.content_zh: Amyloid正体排放分解图(PET)将脑酰胺-β美元量化为标准吸收值比(SUVR),但成本高昂,且不普遍。 结构磁共振成像(MRI)是常规的,等离子体生物标记如磷酸 ta217(p-tau217)正变得实用. 单从核磁共振中合成酰胺PET是不可靠的,因为大脑解剖学很少揭示出酰胺负载. 我们介绍SUPRA(SUVR前导酰胺合成),它将这项任务分为核磁共振和等离子体生物标记两种。 一个回归图将等离子体面板映射到区域SUVR水平,被涂入主体的核磁共振分解上,作为明显的前作. 3D网络随后会增加由核磁共振引导的剩余修正. 输出为绝对SUVR,而该型号也仅在p-tau217上运行. 在阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像倡议(ADNI)组(111个测试对)上,SUPRA达到了23.4分贝的峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR),4个已公布模型的峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR)最高为20.7分贝,在复合皮层、早期积聚地和阶地层中与真实的SUVR的关联度为0.56至0.67,最高为0.24分. 在第二起中,与其他等离子体平台(143个测试对)在认知上没有缺陷的集合,它达到22.8分贝和0.32至0.61分贝,而最高为21.4分贝和0.20分贝. 其酰基正性曲线下面积为0.91和0.82,而最高为0.63。 缩放显示等离子体提供酰胺信息,网络提供图像质量. 将核磁共振与血液试验结合起来,会产生符合实际的合成酰胺PET,并跟踪各区域的负担。

articles.title: Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics
articles.content: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements. In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 光谱:超光谱框架 使用计算机图形生成图像
articles.content_zh: 超光谱图像(HSI)记录了每个像素的全部光谱,因此通过相机的光谱敏感度投射出一个HSI可以给相机的RAW图像,一个HSI可以提供超光谱再生和相机管方法的训练数据. 然而,真实的HSI缓慢而昂贵的捕捉,最大的数据集只持有约1000个图像. 高水平的视野通常会用从3D场景得到的图像来取而代之的稀缺真实数据. 然而,低等任务需要物理上正确的光谱,这需要光谱渲染,对一个场景中的每一个材料都具有被测量到的光谱,而现有的光谱渲染只覆盖了少数场景,大部分是使用简化的图像形成模型. 我们提出Spectrify,一个将三维场景数据集转换为HSIs的框架,以及一个由材料标记的反射光谱库,从近距离超光谱数据集和分光分光计测量中编译而成. 在"光谱"中,光谱跟随了材料:每个物体从物质类别得到一个物理光学模型并测量出反射光谱或光学常数,每个灯具有其类型的排放光谱和天空有模型的日光光光谱,而Mitsuba 3路径跟踪每个场景按波长进行的全部光传输. 我们显示,一个高光谱重建网络只受过合成HSI的训练,它比大多数测试集中最大的真正HSI数据集的网络更好地概括到看不见的真实数据集,而且按照材料类别而不是单用颜色来分配光谱可以改善每个测试集的这种传输。 我们的高级研究所预测的RAW图像也是关于颜色稳定性的有用培训数据,与现有的合成RAW发电机相同。 我们发布了4500个HSI,Spectrify的代码及其材料标记的反射库.

articles.title: Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators
articles.content: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 线性探测器可指南:代表生成器的免费培训控制
articles.content_zh: 代表-空间基因模型,如代表自动编码器(RAEs),主要为加快培训,提高样本忠诚度而利用预先训练的视觉基础模型(VFM). 然而VFM不仅仅是重建活化剂,因为它们的特点是丰富的代表空间,高度有条理,线性可读. 我们观察到,这消除了后热导流的关键障碍:通过期望线性,一个适用于理想的德诺瓦人预测的清洁探测器在任何噪声水平上都得出探测器分数的准确后平均值. 我们称之为"语义平均空间"的这种制度,将语义引导变成了一个贝叶斯线性反向问题,绕过了培训时间调节的需要. 有了这个基础,我们提出LISM, 语义平均空间线性引导的统一框架. 为了验证这一框架,我们开发并调整了不同的解析器,并根据它们如何估计探测器-空间不确定性和如何通过表示来传播校正。 此外,我们提出Fit-Path,这是一个旨在实现强有力的全球和地方控制的解决方案. 我们在四个控制设置(类、属性、前景和关键点)的结果表明,LisM方法,特别是Fit-Path,为全球和地方任务提供了有效、轻量级的控制,超过了噪声意识和像素空间指导。

articles.title: SHARPnP: Self-Supervised and Plug-and-Play Hyperspectral Super-Resolution from Real Noisy Unaligned Camera Measurements
articles.content: Affordable snapshot hyperspectral cameras capture spectral images in a single exposure but suffer from limited spatial resolution and sensor noise. Low-cost RGB cameras provide fine visible details to guide NIR reconstruction, but introduce spatially varying cross-camera misalignment. Supervised fusion methods require relatively large datasets of clean, high-resolution hyperspectral images, are sensitive to sensor noise, and generalize poorly across new sensors. We introduce SHARPnP, an interpretable, flexible framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements without clean references. We adapt a pretrained registration model via a cross-view loss backpropagated through a fixed plug-and-play fusion module. Temporal and recorrupted pairs enable reference-free self-supervision on noisy inputs. At test time, we calibrate cross-camera radiometry and refine alignment. Plug-and-play fusion employs sequential three-band denoising. On the REAL benchmark, SHARPnP outperforms supervised fusion baselines at $4\times$, $8\times$, and $16\times$ on clean inputs and at $4\times$ under Gaussian noise ($σ=5/255, 10/255$). On native RGB-HSI snapshot measurements, it reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands, beyond the conventional 31-band VIS setting, without high-resolution references.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SHARPnP: 自我监督并插接和插接超光谱 超解析度来自真实噪声不匹配相机测量
articles.content_zh: 负担得起的快照超光谱相机在一次照射中捕获光谱图像,但空间分辨率和传感器噪音有限。 低成本的RGB相机提供了细微的可见细节来指导国家清单报告重建,但引入了空间相差相机错配. 被监督的聚变方法需要相对较大的数据集来提供干净高分辨率的超光谱图像,对传感器噪声很敏感,对新传感器的概括性差. 我们引入了SHARPnP, 一种可解释的,灵活的框架 组合注册和重建 RGB 制导的超光谱超分辨率 从响亮的,不相通的测量 没有干净的参考。 我们通过一个固定的插座和游戏聚变模块,通过交叉视差回放来调整一个预先训练过的注册模型. Timor and recorpressed pairs 可以在噪音输入上实现无参考自控. 在测试时间,我们校正了相机的相机辐射测量,并完善了对接. 插管和游戏聚变采用相继三波段去声. 在实际基准上,SHARPnP在监督核聚变基线方面表现优于4美元、8美元和16美元,用于清洁投入,在高斯噪音下达到4美元(σ=5/255,10/255美元)。 在原生的RGB-HSI快照测量上,它重建了所有51个VIS-NIR波段,超出了传统的31波段VIS设置,没有高分辨率的参考.

articles.title: GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?
articles.content: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, video reasoning models remain vulnerable to visual degradation, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical scenarios. Existing benchmarks address this concern in part by simulating visual degradation or probing model reasoning with challenging questions, leaving open how well models handle naturally degraded video and whether they can make the simpler judgments that matter for safe driving. To this end, we introduce GRAPE-Bench, which jointly evaluates video reasoning across visual degradation conditions and question difficulty. It combines a synthetic set spanning twelve corruption types across daily-life and driving videos with real-world footage of driving at night or in rain, snow, or fog. Each video is paired with three progressively challenging questions, from fundamental judgments with potential safety implications to demanding reasoning stress tests. Across open-weight and frontier models, we observe ranking reversals between synthetic and real-world conditions and level-specific weaknesses obscured by overall accuracy. Synthetic-data fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-9B's real-world accuracy from 76.7% to 81.1%, while clean-privileged on-policy distillation reaches 80.4% in a separate reasoning-enabled setting. Through preference steering, we further demonstrate continuous control over a frozen model's trade-off between safety-relevant judgments and challenging reasoning, with little change in overall accuracy. Together, GRAPE-Bench provides a unified testbed for evaluating, improving, and controlling video reasoning under degraded visual conditions.

articles.title: E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt
articles.content: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. articles.title: RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion
articles.content: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

articles.title: Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?
articles.content: Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.

articles.title: RFW-W: Scaling Physical Asset Universes for Generative Embodied Simulation
articles.content: Scaling embodied simulation requires diverse objects with executable physical representations. We present RFW-W, a physical asset universe connecting rigid, articulated, and deformable asset sources to task-conditioned scene composition. Its reported inventories comprise 1,010,386 asset records: 524,611 rigid assets in 1,212 categories (RFW-R), 402,410 articulated assets in 531 categories (RFW-A), and 83,365 jointly verified deformables in 485 categories (RFW-S). These taxonomies contribute 2,228 dataset--category entries. RFW-R couples category-guided generation with collision geometry, composed physical properties, and interaction annotations; RFW-A uses reusable agent-authored procedural generators with explicit part and joint structure; RFW-S uses structure-aware simulation representations, calibration, and independent testing. A common interface preserves physical requirements specific to each asset type for retrieval and scene assembly. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that RFW-R provides broader asset coverage and stronger scene-fulfillment capabilities than existing datasets. Across five RoboTwin tasks, using 100 demonstrations per task for each asset source, policies trained on RFW-R achieve macro success rates of 71.2% in clean settings and 41.8% under randomization, exceeding the strongest baseline by 15.8 and 10.6 percentage points, respectively. RFW-W provides a scalable and unified asset foundation for generating physically grounded, task-conditioned embodied worlds.

articles.title: MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control
articles.content: Physics-based soccer characters must perform diverse motor skills and transition smoothly between them, such as dribbling into a shot. However, skills that perform well in isolation may fail when executed sequentially, as preceding behaviors can leave the character and ball in unfamiliar states. We present MESSI (Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration), a framework that enables multiple soccer skill transitions through shared adaptation while preserving the original skill policy outside transitions. MESSI first trains eight task-competent experts using motion priors and task rewards, then distills them into a unified, skill-conditioned Transformer. Rather than retraining individual experts for different transitions, we train a shared, context-conditioned low-rank adapter on the frozen student through online reinforcement learning. Activated upon skill switching, the adapter helps the target skill handle unfamiliar entry states, while a learned exit mechanism determines when to return control to the original student. By disabling the adapter during native skill execution, MESSI preserves the original student policy by construction. Experiments across individual skills, skill transitions, and continuous skill chains demonstrate substantial improvements over direct switching, including an increase in dribbling-to-shooting success from 19.8% to 61.8%.

articles.title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
articles.content: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

articles.content_zh: 简单的镜像能否揭露出当今机器人操纵政策的局限性? 在动物认知中的镜像自我识别测试的启发下,我们调查机器人政策是否能够可靠地操纵包含其反射的场景中的物理物体. 我们引入了RoboDojo-Mirror,这是建立在RoboDojo基础上的基准,它保留了任务目标、成功标准和政策检查站,同时将无镜基线与单镜、双镜和平面条件进行比较。 跨越愿景-语言-行动模式、世界行动模式和代理政策的五项政策中,每个镜像条件都降低了总体成功率:平均在三个条件下,政策间下降从10.8%到56.7%不等,在镜像台上达到62.5分。 因为一面镜子也是一个物理障碍,所以我们把它与几何相匹配的非反射面板作比较;50-88-XX的镜面特有故障在没有记录的机器人-平面板接触的情况下发生,因此仅直接相撞并不能解释降解的原因. 相反,轨迹和联系分析揭示出与被反射物体的幽灵目标相符合的再现行为和真实物体的空间错位。 有针对性的诊断还进一步说明如何把握近在眼前的反省,以政策为依托推动进步,以及在主要摄像头遮住下进行实际目标互动。 使用0.5美元和FastWAM进行的实际机器人实验也显示,在平坦的模拟和镜像平面条件下,总体成功率较低。 这些调查结果表明,在各种机器人政策中,对反射环境具有共同的脆弱性,并激励对所表现的智能进行反射评估。 代码见https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

articles.title: Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models
articles.content: Visual token compaction reduces inference cost by passing only selected image patches or video tokens to later layers. In sequence models with local convolutions, each removal changes which tokens are neighbors. Learning which tokens to keep therefore requires a training signal that accounts for the new neighborhoods. We introduce ProbConv, which computes the exact expected convolution before activation at a kept position under independent keep decisions. The operator is differentiable in the keep probabilities. With binary decisions, ProbConv and step gating reproduce the compacted Mamba block. Across image, vision--language and video backbones, ProbConv is strongest under strong compaction: its advantage over matched training controls grows as more tokens are removed. In Cobra, it also outperforms adaptations of published vision--language pruning methods at matched inference budgets. ProbConv also improves over matched zero-mask training in video frame selection and speech frame dropping. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gmum/probconv

articles.content_zh: 视觉符号收缩通过只将所选的图像补丁或视频符号传递到后层来降低推断成本. 在有本地演变的顺序模型中,每个去除符号是邻居的改变. 因此,要学习哪些标志性地保留下来,需要有一个培训信号来说明新的街区。 我们介绍ProbConv, 它计算出确切的预期变化 在启动之前,在一个固定的位置 独立保存的决定。 操作者在保存概率上是不同的. 随着二进制决定,ProbConv和相接相接相接再现了紧凑的曼巴块. 在整个图像、视觉语言和视频主干线上,ProbConv在强力收缩下最强:随着更多的符号被去除,它相对于匹配的训练控制器的优势越来越大。 在"眼镜蛇"中,它也优于所公布的视觉语言穿插方法在相匹配的推论预算上的适应. ProbConv还在视频帧选择和语音帧降下方面改进了匹配的零掩码训练. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/gmum/probconv上查阅。

articles.title: One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation
articles.content: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. A Report Card summarises all measures and insights for each generator. We benchmark five public generators on 940 chest CTs and 687 edits of pleural effusion and cardiomegaly, holding out a sixth to test the toolkit. Among them, the most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, while the most responsive produce less realistic and less diverse CTs. The analyses proposed in the literature do not reveal this. We release CtrlCT, its edits, seeds and 30,525 synthetic CTs after acceptance.

articles.title_zh: 一,"无一"和"十万个CT":在文本到CT一代中测试解剖控制
articles.content_zh: 最近,在深入学习和公开提供配对报告的计算成像数据集方面取得的进展,使许多文本到文本生成器成为可能。 然而,它们的评价在预处理和计量方面几乎总是有差异,这妨碍了比较。 此外,他们的协议几乎从未测试编辑报告是如何改变CT的,甚至不是在同一种子上,因此报告常常被假定控制解剖学,而没有证据证明它有多么多和一贯. 因此,我们提出CtrlCT,一个测试发电机的两个特性的工具包,即可靠性和控制。 可信度测试将生成的CT作为人口,与真实的CT和报告进行比较; 控制测试是变形的,不需要参考CT:在固定种子中,编辑一个发现应当按照要求更改,保留否定的发现缺失并转移远方的解剖学不超过一个新的种子,变化应当贯穿种子. 报告卡概述了每个生成器的所有措施和见解。 我们以940个胸口CT和687编辑胸膜取精和心肌增生的5台公共发电机作为基准,持有第6个测试工具包. 其中,最可靠的发电机几乎无法对添加的去液化反应,而反应最迅速的发电机产生的CT更不现实,也更不多样化. 文献中建议的分析并未揭示这一点。 我们释放出CtrlCT,它的编辑,种子和30,525个被接受后的合成CT.

articles.title: First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction
articles.content: Recent neural implicit and Gaussian splatting approaches have achieved impressive results in multi-view surface reconstruction. However, jointly optimizing geometry and appearance introduces ambiguities. A parametric appearance model can compensate for geometric errors, reproducing the input images accurately without an accurate surface. We demonstrate accurate neural implicit surface reconstruction using only multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility, without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models. For each reference ray, sphere tracing computes the first surface intersection. Its position and normal define a local patch whose photoconsistency is evaluated across visible neighboring views using colors sampled directly from the input images. For efficient sphere tracing, we use a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron. We use a single photoconsistency loss, without foreground masks or auxiliary geometric regularization. Experiments show that our method achieves the lowest mean Chamfer distance on BlendedMVS (BMVS) among compared methods and matches the geometric accuracy of leading reconstruction methods on DTU.

articles.title_zh: 神经地表重建的第一发光一致性
articles.content_zh: 近代神经隐含和高斯克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 然而,共同优化几何和外观带来了模糊之处。 一个参数外观模型可以补偿几何出错,在没有准确的表面的情况下准确地复制输入图像. 我们仅使用多视图补丁相容性与以几何为主的能见度,没有容积渲染或参数化外观模型来演示准确的神经隐含地表重建. 对于每个参考线,球体跟踪计算出第一个地表相接点. 它的位置和正常定义一个局部的补丁,其相容性用直接从输入图像中抽取的颜色在可见的相邻视图中被评价. 为了高效的球体跟踪,我们使用1-Lipschitz多层受体. 我们使用单一相容性损失,没有前地口罩或辅助几何规范. 实验显示,在比较方法中,我们的方法在BlendedMVS(BMVS)上实现了最小的平均Chamfer距离,并匹配了DTU上领先重建方法的几何精度.

articles.title: PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users
articles.content: Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.

articles.title_zh: PAVE: 偏好相通的视觉 Egocentral 盲人和低视力使用者的学习
articles.content_zh: 以Egocent为中心视频提问的回答,使得盲目和低视(BLV)用户能够通过自然语言查询其周围环境. 然而,现有的基准和模型主要优化了语义上与参考答案的协议,将视觉协助减少为纯粹的事实匹配任务. 在现实世界的情景中,事实正确的反应如果缺乏用户眼前任务所要求的空间取向、可操作的细节或简洁性,则实际上仍然无济于事。 根据真实的 BLV 自我中心视频和来自EgoBlind 的真实用户查询,我们构建了 PA-EgoQA,一个偏好相通的数据集,按照经验BLV 通信标准重建参考答案. 基于这个数据集,我们引入了PAVE-相通视觉 Egocentral Learning(PAVE),这是一个统一的学习和推论框架,夫妇用确定性问题条件的路由结构化的答案政策微调,在推论时间直接使响应配方适应询问的表面形式. 我们通过Filter-GRPO进一步调整该模型,将分级正确性质量奖励与基于对比的候选人组过滤相配,从事实准确性对比和正确答案中精细的质量差异中提取学习信号。 跨越三个视觉语言主干线的广泛实验表明,事实准确性不断提高,同时在辅助反应质量方面取得了显著提高。 这些成果为将以人为本的应对要求转化为以自我为中心的监督、生成政策和培训后目标确立了具体的范例。 将在https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE中提供代码。

articles.title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
articles.content: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

articles.title_zh: 通过解剖地平面和信心校准进行本土多模式临床模型
articles.content_zh: 从量子计算成形法(CT)中作出结构化的临床决定,需要解剖基础的预测和校正信心估计。 然而,现有的3D医疗多模式往往受到无校正自旋解码和快捷方式依赖无关解剖区域的影响。 我们引入了Redev,一种决定内在的多模式模型,它结合了解剖学引导的视觉压缩,直接的候选预测,以及反事实信心监督. 为将全局上下文与精细的切片细节相接,被冷冻的3D编码器提取出可再使用的器官级特征,这些特征被查询动态地选中,用于处理预测解剖界限内的2D切片特征. 由此产生的紧凑的视觉符号使语言主干线能够在一次前行通行证中估算候选人的概率,而无需自动解码. 我们还提议进行反事实分析培训,以比较在完整和干预的机关表述下所作的预测。 CCT鼓励在去除目标器官证据时降低信心会降低决定质量,同时惩罚过度信任在去除无关器官后下降. 为了便利严格的评价,我们构建了CT-Verdict,一个涵盖二进制查找存在、多重选择问题和对分配和外部群体进行正常严重程度评估的全面基准。 广泛的实验表明,拉德夫在决策精确度和置信度校正方面都大大地超越了最先进的方法,同时在分配变化中普遍地强势地进行. 项目网页https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

articles.title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
articles.content: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

articles.title_zh: AVQ-Attention-2:适应性矢量-量化注意,精确的局部块和线程-成本训练
articles.content_zh: 注意费用为 $\ mathcal{O} (N^2) $, 以符数计算 。 矢量化的注意通过将元元按键组合起来,处理元元的密码字取而代之,以及它的适应形式AVQ-注意,将密码本的分辨率集中在一个查询的注意力质量实际下降的地方. 我们提出AVQ-Attention-2,一种更好的设计,将它与准确的局部关注相合并,并注意每个集群的密钥的平均值,而不是一个代码. 我们显示了三项改进:以可比成本持续提高质量;培训现在也花费$\ mathcal{O}(NM)$,而不是$\ mathcal{O}(N^2)$;以及一个精确的近似值,可以不作微调就把地层扔入预先训练过的变压器. 在各种序列的长度中,结果不仅与其他大致的注意相竞争,而且与精确的密集注意相竞争,运行速度快于FlashAttention,其质量几乎没有损失。

articles.title: When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
articles.content: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

articles.title_zh: 当修复准确性误入歧途时:培训自有故障的VLM
articles.content_zh: 在自身故障上精细地调整视觉语言模型是直接修复的方法,但被搁置故障的准确性,明显的衡量成功,误导. 许多被开采出故障不是模型错误:对Quen3-VL-8B-Instruction的100起故障进行人力审计,发现COCO和GQA产生的问题有37起标签错误. 而被布雷的故障分享了措辞的规律性:只有问题分类器在73.2%被搁置的故障对上得到两个正确的答案. 我们研究了两个有经过核实的故障驱动修复(VFR)的陷阱:打入了最小-pair故障挖掘,由三名LLM判断员进行校验,在没有看到所储存的标签的情况下进行回答,回答第一的校正目标,以及LORA用重放来微调. VFR修复 82.8%的被搁置故障(基准模型:10.0 %),在独立标注的无条件对子上,通过空间关系将总体精度从87.4%提高到92.4%,即使措辞指向错误答案,其精度也从66.7%上升到96.8%. 然而,在对88.9%的被搁置故障进行修复的否定中,对无条件对子的准确性从88.7%下降到79.7%:它打破了对缺失物体的否定,这在它的训练中是罕见的。 未经核实,无条件配对的精确度降至80.8%,低于基准模型的87.4%,通过一个否定的捷径,我们的发展基准被错过;没有选择失败,它保持在92.0%(1个种子),而修理则下降到73.4%。 培训还降低了双相关系准确度(74.3%至49.6%);仅重播数据:48.4%;多相关系重播部分且不均匀地扭转了这种情况。 解释空间问题保留了大部分收益(87.3%对基准模型的62.0%),尽管重新措辞将搁置故障的空间修复率从92.9%降至76.8%。 在What's Up的独立照片中, 标注选择仍然完美, 而我们的"是"/"不是"对"的准确度从84.5%下降到26.4%。

articles.title: NEST: Uncovering and Nesting Unknown Objects in Open-World Object Detection
articles.content: Open-world object detectors aim to localize objects of classes not covered by their training annotations, but most label them only as "unknown". This label tells a system that an object is present but not what it is, while its broader category would allow a more informed decision. We therefore address both uncovering unknown objects and assigning them to the broader categories of a given class taxonomy. For uncovering, we find that most unknown objects are already localized and labeled "unknown" in our base detector, but are discarded during final top-k selection because background receives higher scores. To mitigate this, we propose a class-agnostic ranker that estimates how well each predicted box fits an object and uses these scores to select the final predictions. Across three benchmarks, our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection. For categorizing, we draw on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a category contains the regions of its members. Our categorizer builds each category's region from the known classes and learns how much room to leave for members it has never seen. On the same detections, it categorizes unknown objects more accurately than existing hierarchical methods. Code is available at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NEST: 开放世界对象检测中未覆盖和嵌入未知对象
articles.content_zh: 开放世界物体探测器旨在将未被其训练说明所覆盖的班级对象本地化,但大多数只将其贴上"未知"的标签. 这个标签告诉一个系统,一个物体是存在的,但不是它是什么,而其更广泛的类别将允许一个更知情的决定. 因此,我们既要处理发现未知物体的问题,又要把它们归入某一类分类的更广泛类别。 为了发现,我们发现大多数未知物体已经本地化,并在我们的地基探测器中被标记为"未知",但在最后的上克选择中被丢弃,因为背景得到的分数较高. 为了缓解这种情况,我们建议采用一种不可知级的分级法,用以估计每个预测的盒子是否适合一个对象,并利用这些分数来选择最终的预测. 从三个基准来看,我们的探测器比每项任务最强的基准提高3.8%至195.1%,同时保持竞争性的已知等级探测。 在分类方面,我们参考了欧拉图,其中一类区域包含其成员的区域。 我们的分类人员从已知的班级中构建了每个类别所在的区域,并学会了为其成员留下多少从未见过的空间. 在同一探测上,它比现有的分级方法更准确地将未知物体分类. 代码见https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.

articles.title: Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval
articles.content: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

articles.title: FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues
articles.content: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

articles.title_zh: FocusAnchor:由Anchoring a Deph Foundation 在Focus Cues 之前进行零热度测量

articles.title: VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans
articles.content: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. articles.title: Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

Qune3-VL-8B在注重证据的回答和基础方面显示出同样的广泛改进。 这些结果表明,语义正确性、证据充足性和地基性是不同的能力,应当共同评价。

articles.title: FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices
articles.content: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.

articles.title: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
articles.content: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

articles.title_zh: OmniHarness - RSI: 机能- 智能机能进化促进Omnimoduction
articles.content_zh: 近期在以取用为主的递归自我改进(RSI)方面取得的进展,在不更新基础模型参数的情况下,通过不断发展可执行代理工作流程,提高了对视频的理解. 然而,将这一范式扩大到对全模式的理解仍然具有挑战性,因为多式联运概念和推理的多样性和相互依存性造成了复杂的演化空间,使有目标的利用难以优化。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用Omni Harness-RSI,作为不断演变的利用物剂的模式认识框架。 具体地说,我们把进化空间纳入三个能力维度:模式路由与协作,模式认知的证据本地化,以及模式特定感知. 基于这种因子化,我们构建了一个“因子化-和谐”代理,将专业认知专家和音频视频检索工具结合起来。 我们进一步引入模式引导的利用演化,通过结构化模式能力归属找出缺陷,并通过交互式代码修订和执行反馈完善相应的利用战略. 验证指导性选择和搁置评价评估数据集内部和之间的总体情况。 在WorldSense、Daily-Omni和OmniVideo Bench的实验显示,测试精度分别提高8.86分、8.13分和6.23分,持续地超过模式不可知的RSI。 已进化的被带还展示了不经过改造的跨数据集传输,同时减少了规划者的调用和可查看的框架.

articles.title: ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.
