articles.title_zh: ProX-MAD:将空间背景组合成代表性的代号,用于几发非正常医学检测
articles.content_zh: 少有镜头的医学异常检测(MAD)基本遵循了数据集特有的"一取一取"模式,留下了统一的"一取一取多取"的模型探索不足. 将现有方法自然地扩展到这种环境,导致性能大幅退化,特别是在像素水平上. 我们将此归因于它们的探测机制:在各种损害定义中,共同决定界限变得不可靠,而只有正常的记忆库无法充分覆盖不同的正常分布,很少提及。 我们提出ProX-MAD,这是一个以代理为基础的框架,将空间环境综合为紧凑的,可学习的,针对特定国家的代词,用于统一的几发MAD. 其Masked Proxy Infusion Content(MPIA)模块交叉出入口代理代用符以用于参考补丁特性,并采用代理式的遮盖来保留高自信的函证,缓解代理倒闭,并鼓励多种代理来总结正常和异常的引用. 在所有6个医疗数据集中,ProX-MAD显示的性能只有从一分一到一分一的训练的微弱下降. 尽管只接受过一次统一模式的培训,但即使使用更优惠的一对一协议,它也平均比以往最先进的方法要好,显示了统一多数据集MAD的实用性.

articles.title: Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition
articles.content: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉语言模型知道自己的视觉弱点吗? 测试能力级别
articles.content_zh: 变相认知包括了解自己在各类任务中的优缺点,而不仅仅是判断一个答案是否正确. 我们测试视觉语言模型(VLMs)是否事先知道哪些类型的视觉任务和图像条件对他们来说是困难的,跨越了广泛的开放和专有模型. 因为有些任务对每个模型来说都是困难的,所以我们把一个模型所了解的这个共同的困难与它所了解的自己分开来. 我们发现VLM对视觉弱点知之甚少. 他们误判了他们的总体准确性,甚至不知道对每个模型来说哪类任务都是困难的,而且大多数误判了退化的图像如何影响他们. 我们进一步培训虚拟LM,以预测它们自己的准确性,它教它们自己在培训中看不见的种类上的准确性水平,但对他们来说,哪些种类是困难的。 然而,一旦一个模型开始解决,这些弱点的信息就会出现。 对于一些没有加标签的问题,一个模型给自己的答案分配的概率会随着模型特有的弱点而出现,涉及各种任务和图像条件。 因此,VLM拥有他们自己所宣称的预测尚未反映的弱点的信息. 通过将一个模型特有的内容与每个模型的特性区分开来,我们的评价为旨在教授VLM自身弱点的方法提供了一个测试,答案概率为它们提供了一个起始信号.

articles.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
articles.content: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. For multi-turn conversations, Lembas reuses the tokens processed in earlier turns and refines relevance with the VLM's attention at no extra cost. Our evaluations show that Lembas improves accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points over state-of-the-art baselines at comparable compute. On multi-turn video understanding, Lembas achieves up to 1.5 percentage points higher accuracy with 1.7-17.3x fewer TFLOPs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 Token 分配高效视频检索增强生成
articles.content_zh: 高效的长视频理解需要识别相关证据,同时将视觉语言模型(VLMs)处理的符号降到最低. 现有的视频检索-增强生成(RAG)方法依赖于帧选择和令牌压缩,但忽略了每个附加令牌的价值. 我们引入了Lembas,一个插座和游戏框架,它将视频RAG作为象征性分配问题,超越了共享预算的框架和字幕。 我们的主要见解是,每个项目中,一个标志的价值会减少,随着类似证据获得更多的标志而进一步减少。 莱姆巴斯在一个单一的目标中捕捉出两种效果,并用高效的迭接式填水算法来解决,该算法具有可证明的趋同保证. 对于多回合对话,Lembas重新使用先前回合处理过的活字符号,并在不增加费用的情况下完善了与VLM关注的相关性. 我们的评价表明,在可比计算时,Lembas的准确性比最新基线提高了7.2个百分点。 在多回合视频理解上,Lembas以1.7-17.3x更低的TFLOP达到最高1.5个百分点的精度.

articles.title: HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction
articles.content: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HARI4D:手绘 认识4D 人类-目标互动重建
articles.content_zh: 通过RGB相机对人与对象的相互作用进行解释,对于游戏,VR环境,机器人学习都很重要. 然而,用单相机进行4D重建具有挑战性,特别是在涉及手伸口的情况下。 之前的全体工作在重建过程中忽略了手,导致手被穿入或从物体上浮出. 我们提出HARI4D,一种手动渲染-感知方法,用于从单相光的RGB视频中重建空间和时间上一致的4D人-物体相互作用. 我们引入了一个具有历史认识的物体跟踪器,提供有力而稳定的跟踪. 基于这些轨道,我们通过粗细到细的推理来改进交互配置,这些推理遵循物体操纵的顺序: ReachNet在接触时首先将全身和手臂带入物体,TouchNet再根据时间上下文和局部物体几何来完成手语表达. 在ACTIC上,我们的方法将对象错误减少56%,并将手接触F1从0.866提高到0.921,优于以前的艺术. 我们的方法恢复了准确的全身-物体交互 与连贯的手语,并适用于在线视频。 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型将被释放.

articles.title: IMPACT-Seg: Consistent Anatomical Segmentation and Representation Learning Across CT, CBCT, and MRI
articles.content:
Computed tomography (CT), cone-beam CT (CBCT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary representations of the same underlying anatomy, yet substantial differences in image appearance challenge consistent segmentation and deformable registration in adaptive radiotherapy. We investigate whether dense anatomical segmentation supervision can promote cross-modality correspondence without explicit feature alignment. We introduce IMPACT-Seg, which segments 126 structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI using shared network parameters. A collection of 8,290 volumes was assembled from public cohorts through label harmonization, model-assisted pseudo-label completion, iterative refinement, and 2,864 physics-based CBCT simulations with voxel-aligned CT labels. Unpaired images were used to jointly train 2.5D and 3D residual-encoder networks.
  On 139 real CBCTs, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a mean Dice of 0.842 versus 0.671 for the strongest comparator. On 497 voxel-aligned CT-simulated-CBCT pairs, the CT-to-CBCT Dice decrease was 0.022 versus 0.153-0.178 for competing methods. On independent pancreatic radiotherapy CBCTs, gastrointestinal Dice was 0.735 versus 0.634 for TotalSegmentator. Prediction agreement reached 0.881 on registered CT-CBCT and 0.790 on CT-MRI pairs. Adding MRI training data reduced CT-MRI encoder feature retrieval error from 36.8 to 3.2 mm. Registration pipelines incorporating IMPACT-Seg features ranked first on two multimodal Learn2Reg benchmarks. The 3D model segmented a whole-body CT in 15 s.
  These findings show that dense anatomical segmentation supervision can support consistent anatomical representations across modalities, with applications to both segmentation and registration. Code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/HEMONCedric/IMPACTSeg.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Impact-Seg:整个CT、CBCT和核磁共振之间一致的解剖分裂和代表性学习
articles.content_zh:
计算成的成像法(CT),锥束CT(CBCT)和磁共振成像(MRI)提供了同一种基础解剖学的互补表现,然而在图像外观上存在巨大的差异,在适应性放射疗法中存在一致的分化和变形登记. 我们调查密集解剖分解监督能否促进跨模式通信,而不明确特征相通。 我们引入了IMPACT-Seg,它利用共享的网络参数将126个结构分出整个CT,CBCT,和核磁共振. 通过标签统一、模型辅助伪标签完成、迭代改进和2 864个以物理为基础的CBCT模拟带Voxel-accessed CT标签,从公共群体中收集了8 290个卷。 未发售的图像被用于联合训练2.5D和3D残存编码器网络.
在139个真正的CBCT中,IMPACT-Seg 3D在最强的参照国中实现了0.842比0.671的平分. 在497伏克赛尔相配CT相模-CBCT对上,CT相配-CBCT相配. 相互竞争的方法的剂量下降为0.022比0.153-0.178。 在独立的胰腺放射疗法CBCT中,胃肠道干燥剂为0.735分之0.634分。 预测协议就注册的CT-CBCT达成0.881协议,就CT-MRI对达成0.790协议. 添加核磁共振训练数据将CT-MRI编码器特性检索错误从36.8毫米降低到3.2毫米. 包含IMPACT-Seg特征的登记管道在两个多式学习2Reg基准中排名第一。 三维模型在15 s中将一整体CT分出.
这些调查结果表明,密集的解剖分解监督可以支持各种模式的一致解剖表述,同时适用于分解和登记。 可在https://github.com/HEMONCedric/IMPACTSeg查阅代码、数据集和预先训练过的模型。

articles.title: Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking
articles.content: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 身体视觉跟踪运动有条件的世界模型
articles.content_zh: 世界模型支持通过预测未来环境状况来体现决策。 在所体现视觉跟踪中,不确定的目标运动和机器人引发的视角变化共同影响视觉观测,使未来状态的预测具有挑战性. 我们提出“动能有条件的世界建模”,将预测的目标-动能分布和机器人自我-动能纳入潜在状态过渡。 几何-进步模块通过共享运动模式和路径条件化进度分布,联合模拟几何路径和单步行走距离。 这种提法捕捉路线选择和运动进展的不确定性,同时保持其依赖性. 由动作所引发的坐标转换在下个机器人帧中表达出预测路径,为未来的可视状态预测提供几何基础的条件. 未来的视觉特征重建通过有条件的过渡分支来监督运动预测器,将明确的运动表达与后续观测联系起来. 该模型与运动可能性、特征重建以及专家行动监督共同优化,使跟踪政策能够将视觉上下文与预测运动提示结合起来。 对三项包含的跟踪基准的实验表明,跟踪性能和跨环境通用性都得到了改进,其主干重量为0.5 B美元。

articles.title: Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate
articles.content: A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. M-SYNTH, INbreast and a partial VinDr-Mammo copy passed the few controls run. We release the code and derived tables. There is no quantum component in the inference path.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 标签通过文件头渗出:公共乳房X光学数据集中的几何和批量错解,以及训练前的验收门
articles.content_zh: 一个数据集的诊断标签可以从非诊断信息中取回,产生出高,可再生和不成型的模型性能. 我们应用了预训练控制,只看到图像几何,全局纹理,分集标识符或一个同变分化到6个公用乳房X线照相数据集,而停止阈值为AUC 0.60. 在KAU-BCMD中,光是几何就预言BI-RADS类在本地副本为AUC 1.0000,在公共的Kaggle档案中平均为0.979;再大小后,仅纹理就给出了0.847. 在CMMD中,子收集前缀预测恶性为0.7753;被限制的子收集通过几何(0.5000)和纹理(0.5810),但失败了标识-顺序控制附加后特设(test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM在几何学上超过了停站(集合值为0.654分20分),一种判决统计选择了后临时选择;其官方质量和钙分解没有. M-SYNTH, Inbreast 和一份部分VinDr-Mammo的拷贝通过少数控制运行. 我们发布代码和衍生表格。 推断路径中没有量子组件.

articles.title: DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras
articles.content: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DualSpec: 有优化立体相机的光谱重建
articles.content_zh: 光谱成像能捕捉到普通RGB传感器所不能得到的信息,但专用光谱相机可以昂贵而大宗. 从RGB图像中回收密集光谱提供了一个可访问的替代品,但有区别的光谱可以产生相同的相机响应,产生一个甚至更高级的恢复算法都无法总解决的模糊. 因此,增加获取时获取的光谱信息至关重要。 我们提议DualSpec,一种立体式的获取框架,它联合优化了两个外部光学过滤器和重建网络. 每个滤波器被放入一款标准的RGB相机前,两者被设计为产生为网络提供补充信息的6个响应. 跨越重建架构和光谱范围的实验显示,DualSpec相对于单个RGB相机将平均光谱角度误差减少36-72%,相对于从商业过滤器中选择的立体对则减少11-29%. 跨数据集评价,包括从分散的观点中获取的光谱图像的新基准,表明该方法一般化,而且仍然有力,可以看错对称,而薄膜近似分析则支持光学可行性。

articles.title: Biomechanically Grounded Prediction of Selective Motor Control and Clinical Outcomes from Infant Video
articles.content: Early identification of cerebral palsy (CP) relies on observational assessments of spontaneous infant movement, such as the General Movement Assessment (GMA) and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR), which require trained raters and substantial scoring time. Existing automated approaches derive hand-engineered features from two-dimensional keypoints, which describe image-plane motion rather than the three-dimensional behavior of individual joints. We present Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D), an infant-adapted, biomechanical pipeline that estimates joint-angle trajectories from single-camera video. Against a multi-view markerless motion capture reference in 17 infants, BB3D's median Procrustes-aligned error was 17.5~mm for joint centers and 20.4~mm for marker sites. A spatio-temporal transformer, pretrained on BB3D joint-angle trajectories from 1k+ single-camera recordings, and fine-tuned on 550 videos from 350 infants, predicted each individual BabyOSCAR item with a mean within-site AUC of 0.79 and the BabyOSCAR total with a Spearman correlation of 0.86 on held-out recordings. Without being trained on diagnosis, the predicted total separated infants with CP from those without CP with an AUC of 0.86, exceeding a replicated two-dimensional feature classifier (0.67) but below the expert clinician rater's total (0.97). Predicted scores also carried information about functional ability and body distribution, though less than expert clinician scores. These results show that biomechanically grounded representations of monocular video can support scalable, joint-level assessment of selective motor control in infancy
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 婴儿录像中选择性汽车控制和临床结果的生物机械预测
articles.content_zh: 脑麻痹(CP)的早期识别依赖于对自发婴儿运动的观察评估,如一般运动评估(GMA)和婴儿观察选择控制Appraisal(BabyOSCAR),它们需要经过训练的测出分数和大量的评分时间. 现有的自动化方法从二维键点中衍生出手动的特征,它描述的是图像-平面运动,而不是单个关节的三维行为. 我们介绍婴儿生物力学三维体(BB3D),这是一条由婴儿适应的生物力学管道,它从单相机视频中估算出联合角轨迹. 对照17个婴儿的多视图无标记运动捕捉参考,BB3D的中位数Procrustes-accessed mistory为联合中心为17.5~mm,标记地为20.4~mm. 一台斯皮提奥-时空变速器,从1k+单相机录制的BB3D相接角轨迹上预作训练,并微调了350个婴儿的550个视频,每台BabyOSCAR物品在站内平均AUC为0.79,而BabyOSCAR总共被搁置录音时Spireman相关比例为0.86. 在未接受诊断培训的情况下,预计患有氯化石蜡的婴儿总数与无氯化石蜡的婴儿总数相去甚远,其AUC为0.86,超过了可复制的二维特性分类器(0.67),但低于专家临床鉴定器的总数(0.97)。 预测的分数还包含关于功能能力和身体分布的信息,尽管低于临床专家的分数。 这些结果表明,单视视频的生物机械化定位可以支持对婴儿期选择性运动控制的可扩展联合评估。

articles.title: 3D Tracking Any Point with Events and Frames
articles.content: Tracking a fast-moving point in 3D is prohibitive when RGB frames are blurred or too far apart to reveal its motion. Event cameras record brightness changes between frames, providing measurements inside these temporal gaps. We introduce TrackAnyMotion, which combines monocular RGB frames and events to track arbitrary points in 2D and 3D, including at times when no RGB frame is available. The motion expected for a static point, given scene geometry and camera motion, provides a reference for identifying independently moving objects. An independent-motion decoder combines geometric motion cues with event guidance and 2D tracks, feeding its predictions back into iterative 2D and 3D refinement. We also introduce HyperEvent, a synthetic RGB--Event dataset with high-frequency 3D trajectories, geometry, and independent-motion labels. At RGB frame timestamps on this benchmark, TrackAnyMotion reduces 3D and 2D endpoint errors by 70\% and 32\%, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 3D 跟踪任何带有事件和框架的点
articles.content_zh: 当RGB框架模糊或相距太远而无法显示其运动时,跟踪3D中的快动点是令人无法接受的. 事件相机记录了相框之间的亮度变化,在这些时间间隔内提供测量. 我们引入 TrackAnyMotion,它结合了单相光的RGB帧和事件来跟踪2D和3D中的任意点,包括在没有RGB帧时. 一个静点的预期运动,给定了场景几何和相机运动,为识别独立移动的物体提供了参考. 一个独立-运动解码器结合了几何运动提示与事件引导和2D轨道,将它的预测反馈到迭代2D和3D的完善中. 我们还引入了HyperEvent,一个合成的RGB-Event数据集,有高频3D轨迹,几何和独立的运动标签. 在这个基准上的RGB帧时间戳上,TrackAnyMotion将3D和2D端点错误分别减少70\%和32\%.

articles.title: Simultaneously Boosting Efficiency and Capability for Linear Attention via Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification
articles.content: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同时通过适应性通道压缩和活化提高线性注意的效率和能力
articles.content_zh: 自觉的四维复杂性构成了视觉变形器(ViTs)的核心瓶颈. 现有的以效率为导向的优化,包括基于软马克斯和线性关注(LA)的变体,一般会损害模型代表能力,导致不可避免的性能退化. 我们提出一种新的线性关注,减轻这种效率-能力难题。 我们第一次将一个适应性通道压缩和活性纯化(ACCAP)机制嵌入到线性注意力的QKV投影中,这使得模型在进行减少通道的计算的同时能够保留高维特征信息. 我们进一步将一个有重点的内核功能和一个自标模块纳入ACCAP,以构建一个轻量级线性关注模块(ACCAP-LA)。 我们的理论分析表明,与标准线性关注相比,ACCAP-LA将关注模块的参数数减少了79.17%,FLOPs减少了77.5%。 广泛的实验证明了ACCAP-LA的有效性:当应用到VIT时,它在ImageNet-1K上达到了79.4%的Top-1精度,只有5.8M参数,更值得注意的是,它夸耀出强大的跨结构相容性,将高效ViT-b1和PVT-T分别提升了3.3%和3.4%.

articles.title: MemHand: Memory-Enhanced World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
articles.content: Recovering the continuous world-space motion of both hands from egocentric video is essential for applications such as human-to-robot policy transfer and augmented reality. Achieving this goes beyond reconstructing the hands from each individual frame, as the context that a frame needs is often spread over time, especially around occlusions or when a hand moves out of sight. Recent works have explored how to exploit temporal context, yet they mostly draw it from fixed-length windows. Such windows cannot guarantee that every frame has the context required to reconstruct the hands in world space with accurate poses and metric scale. To address this limitation, we introduce MemHand, a memory-enhanced framework for world-space hand motion reconstruction. MemHand maintains two complementary forms of memory. The Short-Term Event Memory keeps the context of the well-observed hand around each occlusion or out-of-sight event and supplies it to frames with weak or missing visual evidence. In addition, since the metric scale holds over the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory retains the most reliable observations across the video as scale anchors within a bounded state. Across benchmarks featuring severe occlusions and frequent out-of-sight intervals, MemHand achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalizes well to unseen domains. Benefiting from the synergy of both memories, it cuts W-MPJPE by 57\% on ARCTIC and 70\% on HOT3D relative to StableHand, delivering continuous and metrically accurate world-space hand poses and trajectories. We will release our code and models at the project page: https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io

articles.title_zh: MemHand: 记忆增强 从爱高中心视频获得的世界空间手动重建
articles.content_zh: 从以自我为中心的视频中恢复双手不断的世界-空间运动,对于诸如人对机器人政策转移和增强现实等应用至关重要。 实现这一点超越了从每个单个框架重建出手,因为一个框架需要的背景往往随时间而分散,特别是在被隔离或一只手离开视线时. 近期的作品探索了如何利用时间背景,但它们大多取自固定长的窗口. 这种窗口不能保证每个框架都具有以准确的姿势和尺度重建世界空间中的双手所需的背景。 为了解决这一限制,我们引入了MemHand,这是世界空间手动运动重建的记忆强化框架. MemHand保持两种互补的记忆形式. "短期事件记忆"保留了每个隐蔽或外视事件周围的可观察手的上下文,并用弱或缺失的视觉证据提供框架. 此外,由于衡量尺度覆盖整个记录,长期尺度内存保留了整个视频中最可靠的观测数据,作为标定状态下的尺度主播. 在所有以严重隔离和频繁外出间隔为特点的基准中,MemHand实现了最先进的准确性,并很好地概括到看不见的领域。 从这两个记忆的协同效应中获益,在ARCTIC上削减了W-MPJPE57分,在HOT3D上削减了相对于StableHand的70分,传递出连续而直线准确的世界空间手姿和轨迹. 我们将在项目网页上公布我们的代码和模型:https://irmvlab.github.io/memand.github.io。

articles.title: CityRecast: Suppressing Persistent Artifacts in Generative Satellite 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.

articles.title_zh: CityRecast:在基因卫星3D重建中打击持久性活性武器
articles.content_zh: 基于卫星的立体重建由于观测很少和采购日期的变化而受到限制。 现有的方法使用基因学前科来恢复缺失的视觉细节,但幽灵,花纹和模糊在高斯的场景中持续存在. 这些文物在低地外向渲染中变得特别明显. 我们引入CityRecast,通过高斯的场景修复和监督校正来压制这些文物. 为了纠正生产出这些文物的高斯分布,我们首先使用多角取暖来限制它们的空间范围. 这减少了最初的幽灵 被带入逐步完善。 然后由地表制导替换继续修复高斯分布,同时保留现有的外观. 为了对这一过程提供更可靠的监督,观测校正可以减轻多时观测的干扰. 联合改进进一步减少了所产生的意见之间的冲突。 在DFC2019和IARPA的实验中,演示出低穿行渲染过程中减少的文物,同时保持了卫星视忠. 与Skyfall-GS相比,CityRecast在DFC2019上将FID-CLIP减少了25.3%,在IRPA上减少了51.8%. MUSIQ分别增加了14.54分和24.95分.

articles.title: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
articles.content: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DOPER: 深层对象估计重审
articles.content_zh: 我们提出DOPER,一个 RGB 提出的估算框架,它共享一个视觉主干线,跨越物体检测,分化,以及关键点预测,通过Perspect-n-Point恢复已知物体的6D姿势. 从合成训练开始,DOPER在保留合成键点标签的同时,通过部分监督来适应真实的观测. 校正多视图观测为关键点监督提供了几何限制. 在推论中,可选取的热映射精炼直接与所预测的键点分布相接而成的刚性姿势相接而成,在没有深度输入或所学取的姿势精炼器的情况下解决模棱两可的函式. DOPER从规格不高的CAD模型开始,逐渐地精炼出对象的表示并形成估计. 关于SPEED+和SHIRT的结果进一步表明,它们有效地适应了光线的变化,准确的时间估计。 在整个被评价的单景和多景配置中,DOPER在HANDAL,HOPEv2,HOT3D,和T-LESS上实现了最先进的检测AP结果,同时只使用RGB并实时运行(一GB300上每个对象模型35Hz). 这些结果显示了共同学习探测的效果,并提出了关键点,有真实的观测和几何限制.

articles.title: Aqua2CAD : Observation-Guided Point Cloud Correction and Completion for CAD Reconstruction from Underwater Stereo Images
articles.content: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Aqua2CAD:从水下立体图像中校正和完成 CAD 的观测-指向点云
articles.content_zh: 从水下立体图像中恢复可编辑的计算机辅助设计模型需要准确而完整的几何学,而立体重建则会产生被转移点和缺失区域. 原始观点保留了交叉观点分歧和在点云聚变过程中丢失的射线证据. Aqua2CAD利用了这种证据分为两个阶段:取景条件的校正和质量过滤建立可靠的几何支持,而多视图观测则在推断出原始的度量框中缺失的地表之前将一个已学习到的形状作为条件. 回收的点支持表面装配和固体组装,并手动修改面团. 在基于OceanSim的合成基准上,Aqua2CAD相对于立体重建将点-云相差60%. 与匹配的点状完成主干相比,它提高了缺失区域的恢复率,从16.27%提高到24.16%. 由于共用CAD后端,外接接受率从6/19提高到14/19. 部分真实水下捕捉的定性结果显示了6个3D打印物体的主要结构的恢复.

articles.title: SAVERA: Bridging Frozen Vision and Language Models via Sparse Alignment and Visual Evidence Reuse
articles.content: Independently pretrained vision and language models may learn shared structures of the same underlying world, providing a foundation for combining them to build multimodal capabilities. However, a key challenge remains in aligning cross-modal feature representations while preserving access to visual information before and after language adaptation. To this end, we propose sparse alignment with visual evidence-guided residual adaptation (SAVERA), a framework that combines frozen vision and language models through bidirectional alignment in a shared sparse space and prompt-guided residual fusion. Specifically, we first present shared-space projection, activation reconstruction and encoding (SPARE), which represents original visual, adapted visual, and textual features through shared soft-gated sparse encoding, with branch-specific reconstruction to preserve their respective information. Second, we devise bridge--text embedding and activation matching (BEAM), a bidirectional cross-modal alignment module that aligns adapted visual and textual features at both the sample and neuron levels, establishing fine-grained cross-modal correspondence. Finally, we introduce prompt-conditioned residual integration of vision and adapted features (PRIVA), a prompt-guided residual fusion module that models vision--language interactions through gating and attention and integrates complementary information from original and adapted representations through residual fusion. Extensive experiments show that SAVERA achieves competitive performance on image captioning and visual question answering while reducing object hallucination.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAVERA:通过Sparse对接和视觉证据将冰冻的视野和语言模型相接再用
articles.content_zh: 独立地预先训练好的愿景和语言模式可以学习同一个基础世界的共同结构,为将它们结合起来建设多式联运能力提供基础。 然而,在调整跨模式特征表述的同时保留在语言调整前后获取视觉信息的机会方面,仍然面临一个重大挑战。 为此,我们提议与视觉证据指导残余适应(SAVERA)进行微调,这个框架通过在共享的稀有空间中双向调整和即时引导残余聚变,将冷冻视觉和语言模型结合起来。 具体而言,我们首先提出共享空间投影,激活重建与编码(SPARE),它通过共享的软化稀有编码,代表了原始的视觉,被改造的视觉和文字特征,并有分支特定的重建来保存各自的信息. 其次,我们设计了桥-文字嵌入和活化匹配(BEAM),这是双向跨模式对接模块,在样本和神经元两个层面将经过调整的视觉和文字特征相协调,建立精细的跨模式对应. 最后,我们引入了对视觉和适应性特征(PRIVA)的即时有条件的剩余整合,这是一个即时制导的剩余聚变模块,通过取景和关注模拟视觉-语言互动,并通过剩余聚变整合来自原始和适应性表述的补充信息. 广泛的实验表明,SAVERA在图像字幕和视觉问题回答上实现了竞争性的性能,同时减少了物体幻觉.

articles.title: EEG-World: Context-Conditioned Dynamics of the Watching Brain
articles.content: Brain encoding models predict neural responses from audiovisual input, but typically overlook how ongoing brain activity shapes an individual's response. We introduce EEG-World, a recurrent world model that forecasts 10 seconds of EEG band-power dynamics from 6 seconds of preceding EEG and the subsequent audiovisual stimulus. Pretrained on continuous EEG, EEG-World learns shared neural dynamics and adapts to unseen individuals through lightweight subject-specific readouts. Using 2,584 hours of EEG from 78 participants, we show that nonlinear recurrent forecasting surpasses strong history-aware linear baselines at scale. EEG-World achieves a forecasting correlation of 0.261 versus 0.233 for the strongest history-and-video linear model, with a 3.3-second forecasting-horizon advantage. Its learned dynamics transfer to unseen participants, outperforming the linear baseline in 23 of 24 individuals after calibration. While ongoing EEG history accounts for most predictive performance, controlled stimulus analyses reveal an additional video-dependent component. This component also enables evaluation of visual representations, with V-JEPA 2 improving clip-locked prediction by 35% over combined CLIP and DINOv2 features. Our results demonstrate the value of transferable neural dynamics for individual EEG forecasting and highlight the importance of separating state-driven from stimulus-driven predictability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EEG-世界:观察大脑的上下文动态
articles.content_zh: 大脑编码模型预测从视听输入中产生的神经响应,但一般忽略了正在进行的大脑活性如何塑造个人的反应. 我们引入了EEG-World(EEG-World),这是一个经常性的世界模型,它从EEG之前的6秒和随后的视听刺激中预测出EEG波段力动态的10秒. EEG-World通过连续的EEG预训,通过轻量级主题特定读取来学习共享神经动力学,并适应于看不见的个人. 我们利用来自78名参与者的2,584小时的脑电图显示,非线性经常性预测在规模上超过了具有强烈历史认识的线性基线。 EEG-World实现最强历史和视频线性模型的预测相关性为0.261比0.233,具有3.3秒的预测-视距优势. 其学习到的动态向看不见的参与者转移,在校准后超过24人中的23人的线性基线。 虽然目前的EEG历史反映了大多数预测性表现,但受控刺激分析揭示了另一个依赖视频的部分. 这一组成部分还使得能够评价视觉表现,V-JEPA 2将剪辑锁入的预测比综合的CLIP和DINov2特性改进了35%。 我们的结果显示了可转移神经动态对单个电子环境学预测的价值,并突出了将国家驱动和刺激驱动的可预测性区分开来的重要性。

articles.title: Reliable and grounded reporting of any computed tomography scan with FORA
articles.content: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可靠和有根据地报告使用FORA进行的任何计算成像扫描
articles.content_zh: 计算成像仪(CT)的人工智能系统基本上仍限于特定的解剖区域、检查类型或预先确定的异常情况,限制了它们提供全面和基于空间的解释的能力。 我们在此介绍FORA,一种通用的CT模型,该模型承认并空间定位了1,028个按等级排列的放射性概念,并生成我们集团所代表的28个CT协议的报告。 FORA在304 962次常规CT考试中接受了培训,由他们的报告监督,FORA学会将异常情况本地化而无需手动说明损伤. 其架构结合了多层学习与可解释的概念瓶颈,将空间证据,放射性发现和报告生成联系起来. 我们首先对胸腔射线图的架构进行了开发并制定了基准,实现了最先进的性能,然后对三维CT考试进行单独模式的培训. 在36 619个被搁置的CT检查中,FORA在接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下实现了一个0.918的辐射概念识别的宏观区域,超过18个现有CT模型中最强的0.21. FORA在三项公共基准上也排名第一,在自己的测试中表现优于Merlin,没有接受该机构数据的培训(AUROC 0.907对0.826)。 根据肺栓塞、肾脏和肋骨断裂的独立局部化基准,FORA最强的空间证据属于附加说明的损伤范围,其发病率是机会的348倍。 FORA实现了比现有最强报告生成器高三倍多的宏观平均结果召回。 这些结果表明,一个单一模型可以将广泛的异常识别,空间定位和报告生成结合起来,跨越12个CT检查类型,使用常规报告,而不进行损伤级监督.

articles.title: PhysMend: Verification-Guided Program Refinement for Physics-Aware Video Generation
articles.content: Video generative models synthesize realistic scenes, yet their interactions often violate physics. A ball dropped onto sand should displace grains and settle into a crater, whereas a generated video may show it passing through the surface or leaving the sand flat. Post-hoc methods typically score generated videos with a vision-language model (VLM), but such scores offer limited guidance on which object or parameter to modify, and each correction costs another synthesis. Simulation-based pipelines instead run fixed stages before synthesis, so simulation errors reach the video. To address these limitations, we present PhysMend, a training-free framework for verification-guided program refinement. PhysMend describes the target event as an editable physical program of grounded objects, events, and required relations, paired with tunable execution parameters. Our key insight is to verify and repair the event on its simulated rollout and on the depth video that conditions the generator (depth control) rather than on generated videos, enabling quantitative violation measurement, targeted editing, and fast re-verification before synthesis. A hybrid verifier evaluates semantic event consistency, physical plausibility, solver stability, and visibility in the depth control. VLM judgments are confined to event semantics and cannot override failed physical measurements, which limits the impact of VLM hallucinations. Each failed check localizes the program fields eligible for repair, and its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters. Only accepted depth control reaches the generator, which runs once per input. Experiments on the commonly used benchmarks Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, and VBench-2.0 demonstrate substantial gains across different generator backbones; for example, PhysMend raises the overall Physics-IQ score of Wan-VACE from 27.33 to 39.40.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhysMend: 校验指导程序 完善物理-智能视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频基因模型合成了现实的场景,然而它们的相互作用往往违反物理学. 投入沙地的球会取代颗粒并沉入坑中,而生成的视频可能显示它从地表穿过或离开沙地. 后浩克方法一般会用视觉语言模型(VLM)来分分出视频,但这种分数对哪个对象或参数进行修改提供了有限的指导,而每次校正都花费了另一种合成. 基于模拟的管道在合成之前会运行固定的阶段,所以模拟错误到达了视频. 为解决这些局限性,我们提出了PhysMend,这是改进核查指导方案的无培训框架。 PhysMend将目标事件描述为被锚定对象,事件,以及需要的关系的可编辑的物理程序,并配以金枪鱼可执行参数. 我们的关键洞察力是在模拟推出和深度视频上核实和修复事件,这些视频为生成者提供了条件(深度控制),而不是在生成的视频上,从而能够进行定量侵权计量、有针对性地编辑和快速地在合成之前重新核实。 混合验证器在深度控制中评价语义事件的一致性,物理性,解析器稳定性和能见度. VLM判断仅限于事件语义学,不能超越失败的物理测量,这限制了VLM幻觉的影响. 每个失败的检查都会将符合修复条件的程序字段本地化,并且其测量到的违反尺度会对其参数进行有限度的更新. 只有接受的深度控制到达生成器,每输入一次运行. 常用基准物理-IQ,PhyGen Bench,和V Bench-2.0的实验显示不同发电机主干线间有很大的增益;例如,PhysMend将Wan-VACE的总物理-IQ分从27.33分提高到39.40分.

articles.title: Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
articles.content: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实时互动视频生成剩余指南
articles.content_zh: 实时交互式视频生成可以让用户在生成过程中更改提示来引导正在演化的视频. 然而,现有的流出模式,即逐块生成视频,往往在切换后跟随上一个提示. 我们追踪到这种失败的来龙去脉,在这种情况下,先前的块是压制新快件的强大前奏。 此外,我们发现,即使缓存只保留了先前的块,但丢弃上下文会打破视觉连续性,从而限制了编辑缓存的方法,这种惯性仍然存在. 我们不编辑缓存,而是提出"残余指导"(RG),这是一种简单的,无训练的方法,用缓存外测得的校正来抵消上下文惯性. 具体地说,RG denoises在新快报下一次重新点名的上块,没有缓存,并在下块的早期去点名步骤上添加所形成的剩余部分,其内容基本确定,而新快报被最压制. 在从单一开关到长多开关生成等各种设置中,RG大幅度地提高了现有流线模型(包括具有专用开关机制的流线模型)的即时开关能力,同时在很大程度上保持了视觉质量. 由于RG不需要培训或按型号进行调试,每块只增加一个前行通道,因此RG可以很容易地被整合到现有的实时视频生成管道中.

articles.title: Beyond Image-Text Pairs: Aligning Semantic Changes for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
articles.content: Image-text alignment serves as a foundation for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet prevailing training paradigms provide limited supervision for learning how semantic changes correspond across modalities. To address this limitation, we propose a post-training method that learns cross-modal semantic change correspondences through controlled visual and textual variations. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic Difference Alignment (SDA) loss which can align the directions of corresponding visual and textual representation changes. We combine our proposed SDA with pairwise sigmoid matching to jointly learn image-text correspondences and cross-modal semantic changes, encouraging more fine-grained and discriminative visual representations. To support this learning, we construct VarFamily-40K, a dataset of image-text pairs with controlled cross-modal semantic variations. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in compositional understanding and downstream classification performance, alongside further gains on multimodal tasks when the adapted visual encoder is integrated into VLMs.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Image-Text Pairs:为精致视觉理解而调整语义变化
articles.content_zh: 图像文本对接是现代视觉语言模型(VLMs)的基础,但流行的培训模式对学习语义变化如何适应不同模式提供了有限的监督。 为了解决这一限制,我们提出一种训练后方法,通过受控的视觉和文字变化来学习跨模式语义变化的函文. 具体地说,我们引入了语义差异对齐(SDA)损失,它可以对接相应的视觉和文字表现变化的方向. 我们将我们提议的SDA与对等相配的Sigmoid结合起来,共同学习图像文本对应和跨模式语义变化,鼓励更多的精细和有歧视性的视觉表现。 为支持这种学习,我们构建了Var Family-40K,一个图像文本对的数据集,具有可控的跨模式语义变异. 实验表明,在将经过调整的可视编码器纳入VLM后,在多式联运任务方面,对组成理解和下游分类性能的不断改进,以及进一步的收益。

articles.title: SpatialArena: Where Do Geometric Foundation Models Stand?
articles.content: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry. However, their progress cannot be measured reliably. Published numbers are not comparable, because every paper samples frames, sets resolutions, and selects test splits differently. They are not robust because the alignment required for every up-to-scale prediction can outweigh the gap between models: fitting depth in the wrong space nearly triples its error, and standard trajectory alignment understates the error of failing methods by up to $2.6\times$. And they rarely cover long recordings, dynamic scenes, or aerial views. We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular depth to SLAM. It covers 23 public datasets with 418,929 images across indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, and dynamic scenes, together with Spatial Arena, our own captures with accurate poses and depth. Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models. The benchmark, toolbox, and leaderboard will be publicly released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpaceArena:几何基础模型站在哪里?
articles.content_zh: 3D感知正从任务特定管向几何基础模型转变:单相通深度网络,向导3D/4D重建模型,以及预测几何的视觉语言模型. 然而,不能可靠地衡量它们的进展。 已公布的数字不相上下,因为每张纸样本框,设定分辨率,选择测试分数不同. 它们不健全,因为每个最新预测所需的校正可以超过模型之间的差距:在错误的空间中安装深度几乎是错误的三倍,标准轨迹校正低估了失败方法的误差,最高可达2.6美元。 而它们很少覆盖长录音,动态场景,或者空中取景. 我们提出空间空间(SpaceArena),这是一个开放的竞技场,它以同样的度量衡和规则对几何模型进行评分,并进行有力和决定性的调整。 SpaceArena跨出从单相深度到SLAM的五个任务. 它涵盖23个公共数据集,其中418 929个图像横跨室内、室外、空中、以物体为中心、动态场景,还有空间竞技场,这是我们自己用准确的姿势和深度捕获的。 评估52个模型,我们发现,在公共基准上,单像深度接近饱和度,但是在大型的,不受控制的场景上,现在的进展来自于跨帧和观点的一致性,其中向导的3D/4D模型匹配或超越了单像专家,并超越了视频深度模型. 基准、工具箱和领导板将公开发布。

articles.title: Back to Raw Motion: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Motion and Exact Conditional Generation
articles.content: As generative models tackle larger and more complex datasets, learned codecs enable efficient generation through compact latent representations, but may lose details and cannot guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Generating directly in the original data space avoids errors introduced by the codec. Recent advances in image generation demonstrate that pixel diffusion can produce high-quality samples at practical computational costs. Inspired by these advances, we conduct a preliminary study of pixel diffusion, demonstrating its potential for adaptation to motion generation. Building on these findings, we present RawMo, a framework that brings text-to-motion generation to raw motion space. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) models local skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, while refining motion across frames to improve temporal consistency. Working directly in raw motion space further allows our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve text consistency without intermediate motion decoding. RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single conditional model while preserving given motion conditions exactly. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show the best text alignment among compared methods and competitive motion quality, with ablations confirming the benefits of MiT and HiNCE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 回Raw Motion:用于文字到运动和精确条件生成的Latet-Free Divusion变换器
articles.content_zh: 由于基因模型处理的是更大和更复杂的数据集,所学的编码器通过紧凑的潜在表示可以有效生成,但可能失去细节,无法保证确切保存特定条件。 直接在原始数据空间中生成,可以避免解码器引入的错误. 图像生成的最新进展表明,像素扩散能够以实际的计算成本产生出高质量的样本. 受这些进步的启发,我们对像素扩散进行了初步研究,展示了其适应运动生成的潜力. 基于这些发现,我们提出了RawMo,一个将文字到动作生成带入原始运动空间的框架. 我们的运动分化变形器(Mition Diffusion Transformer (MIT)) 模拟了局部的骨骼结构和全身动力学,同时精炼了跨帧运动来提高时间一致性. 直接在原始运动空间中工作,进一步使我们的高噪音文本-运动对齐损失(HinCE)在不进行中间运动解码的情况下提高文本的一致性. RawMo支持多个具有单一条件模型的动作调节任务,同时准确保留给定的运动条件. 关于HumanML3D和KIT-ML的实验显示比较方法和竞相运动质量之间的最优文本相接,并有活化证实MiT和HINCE的好处.

articles.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
articles.content: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiaCap:联合学习谁在视听对话时说话
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍DiaCap,这是一个用于全面对话字幕的视听LLM,它制作记录稿、时间戳和视频中每句话的发言者的视觉描述。 考虑到话语时间和视听分化紧密结合,DiaCap将任务统一在一个模式中,经过两个互补阶段的培训。 首先,我们用225K编译的剪辑来训练DiaCap, 使用合成的字幕, 其次,我们通过对2.9K人修补的剪辑进行强化学习,利用精细的反馈,直接评价发表时间、演讲者分组和演讲者捆绑,进一步完善模型。 在DiaDem Bench上,我们用语音级别的时间戳和字幕编辑来扩展它,DiaCap与现成的笔录及其端到端的变体DiaCap-E2E都取得了很强的成果. 具体来说,DiaCap在视听分化方面与双子座4Argon同等,同时在时间戳准确性方面明显地优于双子座(76.59对42.76 Time)。 它还对多语种和短片录像保持强烈的分化,并转而回答视听问题。

articles.title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
articles.content: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CoT-Proxy:用于稀释长视野政策的跨格式转移
articles.content_zh: 理性模型通过强化学习或更便宜地通过微调更强的教师轨迹而成为了长相视野的代言人,这些代言包含教师的思想链及其行动. 标准微调方法模仿两者,然而最强的教师是封闭模型,其思维链被隐藏在API后. 我们显示,思维链可以完全忽略,长远政策可以从老师的行动中提炼出来. 学生接受过这些轨迹的培训,其推理块被留空了,而KL在自己世代的回放缓冲器上的损失限制了从最初的模型上漂移. 令人惊讶的是,从这些带有空洞推理屏障的轨迹学来的政策, 继续推导出思维的功能, 学生们在自己风格上的理由, 同时又像老师一样, 我们称之为跨格式转移。 将Qwen3.6-27B的动作分解,将Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上的任务成功率从7%提高到18%,而Quen3-32B的任务成功率从12%提高到25%. 我们进一步介绍CoT代理, 简略总结老师在空推理块之后的推理, 由于无论是行动还是CoT代理都不需要隐藏的思想链,因此秘方适用于封闭的教师。 在AppWorld上将 Qwen3-4B 的 7% 提升到 48% , 在 SWE-bench 上从 3% 提升到 28% 。

articles.title: BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation
articles.content: Language models can generate LEGO$^\circledR$ assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model's next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model's predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model's choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model's next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO$^\circledR$ formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.

articles.title_zh: BriConstruction: 自动硬砖大会生成的几何限制解码
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以生成 LEGO$ {} 循环 文本中的R$组件,但其构件中往往含有相撞或无所附属的部件. 通常拒绝并重印无效放置的方法,在不保证有效构建的情况下丢弃已解码的令牌. 我们提出BriConstractin,一种受限制的解码方法,在采样前限制一个预先训练的语言模型的下个托肯概率,引导它向有效的放置. 由于一砖放置的有效性取决于未确定的建构状态,因此无法被编译为固定的语法,必须进行动态检查. 然而,在采样前检查一砖的有效性具有挑战性,因为有效放置的空间组合起来很大,无法详尽列举。 我们的关键思想是通过限制部件如何相接而不是限制哪些部件相接来缩小搜索空间. 具体地说,鉴于模型对目前被放置的部分的预测,以及它想要连接的先前被放置的母体,我们制约了模型对它们如何接合的选择. 这使得我们能使用预计算出几何甲骨文来覆盖部分附件的空间,并有效地过滤出相撞选项. 有了有效的附件候选人,我们把模型的下一份分配偏向于其余有效的候选人。 我们用两个LEGO$ 来评估我们的方法 R$格式和模型: BrickNet,它明确注释连接,以及我们提议的隐性连接LDraw格式(ICLF),它使用数字值来进行投放,并隐含连接. 我们的方法将BrickNet的无相撞建筑从31%提高到91%,将ICLF的无相撞建筑从15%提高到65%,并且两种格式的拒绝取样都超过其解码成本的60%。

articles.title: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
articles.content: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.

articles.title_zh: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient 编辑器停止一个小语言模型的思维循环并补充一个前沿模型的重量编辑器
articles.content_zh: Quen3.5-0.8B很少在思维模式中完成推理:在4,096个托肯预算中,500个MATH-500答案中只有1或2个关闭了他们的思维块(两个种子),准确率为15.4%. 最近的一项示范活动是GPT-6 Astra编辑了131,072个模型的重量,没有梯度,并报告说,在32,768个托肯预算时,MATH-500从7.9%上升到48.1%。 我们提供了缺失的梯度基线,然后合并两个编辑。 仅微调140至139 750个梯度最大的重量,在模型自己正确解答MATH训练问题后,将思维-模式MATH-500以4k符号提升到39.0至45.5%,在一个GPU训练了2-9分钟后;50个训练实例足够了,1 398个随机位置只给出了16.3%. 梯度将编辑集中在前三层每一层最接近恒定的信道上。 由于模型没有偏差术语,局限于这些通道的编辑会起到为剩余流所添加的恒定向量的作用:在未经编辑的模型中添加三个固定向量与这种编辑的准确性相匹配. 根据Astra协议(32k令牌,存在罚单 1.5),Astra编辑在我们复制中得分52.1%(完成并正确),我们全能编辑达到45.6%-45.7%,但我们在每个预算上获得最多为16k令牌的得分(39.5%对6.7%为4k). 两种编辑互为补充. Astra编辑加上我们139 750 个重的编辑, 半强度分62.2%,

articles.title: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
articles.content: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAG-Mem-1.0技术报告
articles.content_zh: 长期的对话记忆需要取回分散在对话会中的补充事实,包括与原问题有有限相似性的中间证据. 现有方法往往依靠衍生的内存表示或持续的关系结构,引入了施工成本并有可能丢失源细节. 我们提出SAG-Mem,这是一个对话记忆框架,它以非重叠块保存完整的对话信息,并通过查询-时间语法扩展发现补充证据. 内存构造不需要模型推论,不用LLM的提取,归纳,或语义关系构造而使用词典索引. 在查询时,BM25检索了初始候选人,一名证据评估员鉴定了有用的块,选定证据的词汇提示指导了额外的检索回合。 检索到的对话还附加了对支持的相对时态的日历解释,保留了原始措辞和时间颗粒性. 我们还采用了SAG-Mem-Lite,这是一种替代配置,用嵌入式候选人分数取代证据分数,实现比Full Control和所有基于内存的基线更低的运行成本,同时使用低查询间隔的基准。 在"LoCoMo"和"LongMemEval"上,SAG-Mem的总分分别为83.08分和80.20分,是两个基准上评价方法中最高的. 在LongMemEval上,它超过了最强的基线7.20分. SAG-Mem-Lite分别取得了77.09分和77.20分的分数. 这些结果支持对话保存和由证据指导的检索扩展,作为长期对话记忆的有效设计.

articles.title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
articles.content: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

articles.title_zh: AIChip Bench:用于自动AI加速器设计的基准LLM代理
articles.content_zh: 一个语言模型的解码器在解码步骤之间携带状态,在硬件中,错误的状态更新可以让当前符号正确并腐蚀后数个符号输出,因此一个设计可以通过输出测试,仍然是错误的. AIChip Bench 问 LLM 编码代理需要什么来正确构建这样的硬件. 代理在可合成的注册-传输级(RTL)代码中执行已定量的Qwen3.5,Gemma 3,Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器,对应一个可执行的整数引用,指定每个解码步骤的输出和被存储状态. 他们对照固定预算下的公开测试进行调试;他们的被冻结的设计被分级到被搁置的代号序列,重置,内存摊位,和合成上,第二道赛道要求他们在近固定区域加速正确的设计. 在4个编码剂的9,136次尝试中,困难在于存储状态. 指向第一个状态不匹配的反馈在匹配研究的所有12个代理任务细胞中,提高接受率,高于只输出的反馈,达到25.0至46.9个百分点,并将每个被接受的设计的代理小时减半. 根据新的序列和条件重新定级,69个被接受的设计中有45个在所需的32个步骤内失败. 超过三分之一的尝试试图在没有设计时加快正确的设计端. 总体分数在Astra 6和Opus 5.5以上排名Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1,在全部200个随机分出的情况下,两者的一半都给出了这个顺序. 因此,硬件代理需要调试能暴露存储状态的反馈,其基准需要远远超出开发案例的最终测试.

articles.title: FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

articles.title_zh: FOL-Proof:通过定断语义验证 LLM 文本到逻辑翻译
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于将自然语言语句翻译为一等逻辑(FOL)来改进推理. 然而,LLMs容易出错,因此一个充满恶意的FOL公式会腐蚀下游推理. 我们提出FOL-Proof,一个语义防火墙管道,它验证LLM生成的FOL翻译与独立衍生的语言解释. FOL-Proof的操作方法是通过语义分析工具,如英语资源语法和最小回溯语义等,确定获得一个候选翻译集合;然后应用一个SMT解析器来检查所衍生的每个读取与LLM生成的公式的逻辑等同. 如果译名是忠实的,则被接受;否则就被拒绝,或者通过反复引用LLM来选择修复. 程序是保守的:搜索不全,没有支持的构建,或者没有定论的检查结果为弃权而不是虚假的拒绝. 我们根据既定基准(ProofWriter、RulesTaker和PrOntoQA)以及新的对抗性基准(LongFaithCheck)评估了FOL-Proof。 我们的实验显示,FOL-Proof的精确度接近完美的选择性,而直接的LLM判断和回程基线则显示性能差得多。

articles.title: Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement
articles.content: Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer's chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena's designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.

articles.title_zh: 值得等待吗? 如何回应时间和流化 常规AI的判断 答和聊天人参与
articles.content_zh: 来自基于大语言模型(LLMs)的基因AI聊天器的回答现在得到的速率非常不同:推理模型在回答前经过深思熟虑,而响应缓存则可以立刻返回一个被存储的回答. 对这些模式进行排序的盲从偏好投票被理解为对其文本的判断,如果交付很重要,预计更快的答案会得到. 研究劳动假象和文字在屏幕上的出现表明, 正在写作的答案会立刻被记在同一个答案上。 我们用自然用途的三种不同来源来检验这些账户。 首先,compar:IA,一个法国政府聊天机器人竞技场,以随机抽取的方式答覆了重复的提示,或者用写作时的新鲜答案流出,或者用同一模型存储的更早答案,同时显示. 在同一快板内,回放将一个答案赢得决定性盲票的机会降低了25.8%. 同样的被存储的文本在流出时赢得了57%的决定性选票,在重放时赢得了29%的选票,选民称其不完全,更肤浅,在重放时往往不正确. 第二,供应商拥挤减缓了流出答案。 在324,029个对话中,较慢的回答在投票中没有获得可被察觉到的净信用,但较慢的首次交换使得游客不太可能提出后续问题. 第三次,4 378 514次 疯狂 每日聊天回复 ChatGPT的使用,因拥堵而减速的回复使得用户不太可能继续使用. 交付移动了盲票,方向与竞技场的设计者预期的相反,同时等待成本后续问题,当两个答案比较缓慢时,这两个答案无法注册. 结果涉及AI服务缓存和流解答方式,它们如何预算延迟,以及偏好领导板如何评价模型.

articles.title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
articles.content: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

articles.title_zh: 后期合并:超网络生成的LORAS的后期空间组成
articles.content_zh: 最近的工作提出了超网络,将一个文档转换成一个低等参数更新(LORA)在一个单一前行通道中,可以快速地将新知识注入被冻结的LLM. 然而,为每个文档存储单独的LORA适配器在流环境中可能是不可持续的. 在本文中,我们研究利用Doc-to-Lora和SHINE这两个代表性系统编组超网络生成的LORA的问题. 我们显示,超网络生成的LORAs的几何学与直接微调的LORAs有很大的不同. 它们的光谱集中度更高,跨文件的对接能力也比下个托肯预测和QA微调适配器更强,这些适配器是分散的,几乎横跨文件的正交. 本着这一看法,我们提议将潜入空间的LORA合并。 我们组成中间超网络潜伏器 然后通过冷冻的LORA生成头解码合并潜伏器 我们显示,潜在空间合并技术在保持单一固定等级适配器的同时,在重量空间和系数空间基线方面不断改进。 这些成果支持潜在的空间构成,作为将超网络产生的LORAs结合到固定产出级预算中的一种有希望的机制。

articles.title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.

articles.title_zh: 对基于LLM的推荐系统进行不确定性量化的现实评价
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)为推荐系统提供了灵活的接口. 然而,它们发布的排名需要可靠的实例一级的不确定性监测。 在这种假想中,比较不确定性量化(UQ)方法变得具有挑战性,因为LLM分级器缺乏标准的项目分类头. 他们的分数可能取决于选项标签、提示、生成程序以及可用的用户和项目证据。 现有方法从不同来源产生不确定性,并应用于建议过程的不同阶段。 有些方法评价已发布的排名,而另一些方法则使用不确定性来改变排名本身,使直接比较变得困难. 在此,我们采用一个固定等级基准,根据共同产出合同,将八个不同的UQ信号作为记录级监测器加以评价。 我们通过四个推荐数据集和两个LLM主干线根据一个共享的固定等级协议来评价这些信号. 从结果中,我们得出了三个主要意见。 首先,UQ方法甚至在相同的参考实例中命令跨主干线的改变. 其次,排名相通的Top10Mass在多个评价条件下提供了最强的scalar Error@10检测,反映了有效的截断相通监测,而其优势则缩小了受欢迎-尾等目标. 第三,Scalar UQ信号在识别哪个控制有较大的剪接NDCG@10差值时很弱,而源特定信号,包括Perturbation Rank不稳定性和简单的列表距离,提供了更强的对接控制协议,反映了它们对两个被控制的证据源的敏感性. 这些结论促使我们评价排名失败检测、建议条件的强性以及对控制下的证据变化的反应,视其为UQ的独特属性。

articles.title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
articles.content: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2's quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq

articles.title: SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

articles.title_zh: SALSA:为LLM安全评估从学到的分发量中抽取优等后缀
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)仍然容易受到越狱攻击,对手将最优化后缀附加到否则良性外观的提示来绕过安全对接. 现有的以优化为基础的GCG型攻击可以有效,但在推断时间却很昂贵,并且受到转会不良之苦. 我们提出,SALSA, 一个基因框架, 学习一个分布 越狱后缀 从优化衍生的攻击蝎子。 该模型经过培训后,支持高效的采样攻击。 在开源目标上,它实现了能与最先进的优化基线相媲美的攻击成功率,同时将生成时间从每快3.46s减少到0.04s. 在黑箱转移中,它仍然对专有系统非常有效,包括GPT-3.5-Turbo上的99%ASR,在大幅更硬的GPT-4o上达到45%ASR,在同等采样预算中比最强的基线增加一倍以上. 我们进一步提供了一种直觉,说明为什么基因取样能够保持高攻击成功,而当时所学的后缀分布接近于优化输出的分布. 总体而言,我们的结果显示,学习对抗性后缀分布为持续发现LLM脆弱性提供了可扩展的、实际有效的基础。

articles.title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
articles.content: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

articles.title_zh: 能 LLM 吗? 法官抓住不安全的临床行动? 错误注入研究
articles.content_zh: 随着临床AI剂开始与电子健康记录(EHRs)互动,大语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地被用来评价它们的行为. 但是,这些法官如何能够可靠地认识到临床上危险的错误,特别是当一名特工似乎成功地完成了任务时? 我们利用Bench医生 来调查这个问题 将受控制的临床误差 引入经核实的毒剂轨迹 实验包括了416个出错的轨迹,8个出错类别,以及6个开量LLM裁判. 通过将每个错误的轨迹与正确对应的轨迹进行比较,我们衡量法官是否真正认识到错误,而不是简单地将更多的行动标出为不安全。 调查结果显示,获得临床证据可大大提高判断的可靠性. 当仅显示最终答案时,法官无法区分那些使其保持不变的错误,同时标出56%的正确轨迹. 有了完整的轨迹信息,将不安全的行动与正确行动区分开来的能力达到0.75分,而提供实际的EHR反应使歧视增加了0.39分. 出人意料的是,包括该剂的推理并不能改善总体性能,并减少了对错误报告的临床值的检测0.18,这仍然是最难发现的错误. MedGemma的表现比通用模型更糟糕,是错过潜在危险药物过量剂量的唯一判断者. 我们还发现,该基准的原始分级器接受所有38个轨迹,同时故意跳过实验室检查,同时将LLM判断器与基于规则的检查器结合起来,根据完整的EHR记录,检测出97%的注射断层.

articles.title: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

articles.title_zh: Leto: 功能-子代理内存
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理依赖于外部内存来保留和再利用跨相互作用的信息. 现存的记忆系统将记忆视为过去的记录,并通过忠于对话来评价. 然而,记忆的价值在于它是否改善了代理的反应. 记忆系统决定了在回应存在之前要记住什么和要服务什么,忠诚度则不检查对它的决定. 因此,忠实的记忆可能无法改善反应。 相反,我们把记忆视为一个预测问题,并呈现出\textbf\emph\leto\x,一个LLM代理的记忆系统,它专注于记忆对未来的效用,而不是它对于过去的忠诚. 由于未来的请求未知,\emph\leto\通过内存索引来保存对对话细节的获取,使得信息能够通过其出处继续提供. 当一个请求到达时,内存重放会利用这个索引来预测和提供代理商需要的上下文,超出请求明确规定的范围. 在生成响应之前,服务上下文的效用仍然不确定,这激发了一个利用响应结果来完善未来内存选择的效用循环. 我们对照六个记忆系统评估我们的系统,这些系统有五个基准,涵盖三种情况。 在个性化方面,它在PrefEval上精确度超过比较最强的内存系统16.3个百分点,在PERMA上完成任务时则超过3.1分. 对于长距离任务,它实现了记忆阿雷纳平均在5个环境中的最佳整体性能,其收益随着链深而增加. 根据对长文的理解,它与原始历史的检索是等同的,而上下文的符号较少。

articles.title: Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration
articles.content: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.
