articles.title_zh: 通过 LLM 模拟双语学习 培训:关键 -- -- 预测勘探
articles.content_zh: 获取第二语言(L2)的临界期账户表明,学习新语言的能力可能取决于如何容易地修改先前获得的第一语言(L1)知识。 这一探索性计算研究通过检查内部表现而不是行为,将神经语言-模型方法延伸至临界期影响. 一个小型的两层GPT-2模型通过序列式训练或弹性重量综合(EWC)接受了英语培训,然后接受了德语(一种相对相关的L2)或芬兰语(一种相对遥远的L2)的培训,这限制了对英语重要的参数变化. 将每种语言20个被搁置的探测句的均聚式隐藏状态与仅使用英语的模型相比,在嵌入层使用同位素相似性,在一和两个L2纪元后使用两个变压器层. 在变压器层中,英语的相似性仍然很高,但在嵌入层中变得阴性. L2在变压器层的相似性增加,德语和芬兰语在第二变压器层的相差大于第一层. EWC将费舍克加权参数漂移减少了约6%,但改变了变压器层的相似性还不到.001. 通过每个条件进行一次培训,这些结论是初步的。

articles.title: On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models
articles.content: Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基础模型的潜力和作用
articles.content_zh: 基础模型是通过大规模前期训练来构建的,通常之后是后期训练,然后被适应具体的任务和行为. 但是,适应是否增加了真正的新能力,还是基础模型已经掌握了? 我们把因不同调整而导致的更新分解成所有投入共享的组成部分和随投入而变化的剩余部分。 我们发现,共享的组件足以满足大多数适应增益,并且可以直接学习:一个能学习每层恒定向量的转动适配器,与每层输入完全相同,复制了LORA的行为并完全微调. 我们称这是基础模型的潜力原则:基础模型已经包含了针对具体任务的专门知识所需的能力。 为了适应新的任务,模型只需要被实现,即通过不断的,输入独立的转变来向某个方向推进. 我们显示了这一原则对参数效率高的适应、引导和各种模型的趋同的影响,以及它如何解释神经厚度现象。

articles.title: When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
articles.content: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

articles.title_zh: 当修复准确性误入歧途时:培训自有故障的VLM
articles.content_zh: 在自身故障上精细地调整视觉语言模型是直接修复的方法,但被搁置故障的准确性,明显的衡量成功,误导. 许多被开采出故障不是模型错误:对Quen3-VL-8B-Instruction的100起故障进行人力审计,发现COCO和GQA产生的问题有37起标签错误. 而被布雷的故障分享了措辞的规律性:只有问题分类器在73.2%被搁置的故障对上得到两个正确的答案. 我们研究了两个有经过核实的故障驱动修复(VFR)的陷阱:打入了最小-pair故障挖掘,由三名LLM判断员进行校验,在没有看到所储存的标签的情况下进行回答,回答第一的校正目标,以及LORA用重放来微调. VFR修复 82.8%的被搁置故障(基准模型:10.0 %),在独立标注的无条件对子上,通过空间关系将总体精度从87.4%提高到92.4%,即使措辞指向错误答案,其精度也从66.7%上升到96.8%. 然而,在对88.9%的被搁置故障进行修复的否定中,对无条件对子的准确性从88.7%下降到79.7%:它打破了对缺失物体的否定,这在它的训练中是罕见的。 未经核实,无条件配对的精确度降至80.8%,低于基准模型的87.4%,通过一个否定的捷径,我们的发展基准被错过;没有选择失败,它保持在92.0%(1个种子),而修理则下降到73.4%。 培训还降低了双相关系准确度(74.3%至49.6%);仅重播数据:48.4%;多相关系重播部分且不均匀地扭转了这种情况。 解释空间问题保留了大部分收益(87.3%对基准模型的62.0%),尽管重新措辞将搁置故障的空间修复率从92.9%降至76.8%。 在What's Up的独立照片中, 标注选择仍然完美, 而我们的"是"/"不是"对"的准确度从84.5%下降到26.4%。

articles.title: "I Do Intend to Deliver": Will LLMs Run a Marketplace Advance-Fee Scam?
articles.content: Online fraud is traditionally limited by the cost of the human labor needed to talk to potential victims. We ask whether hosted large language models will now supply that labor. We prompted ten off-the-shelf models to play the seller in the "free item, just pay delivery" advance-fee scam common on buy-and-sell sites, using a plain system prompt with no jailbreak. Each model played 30 conversations against each of four buyer personas, from credulous to guarded, with the same model playing the buyer (1,200 conversations). We label each conversation by what happened to the buyer's money, and validate the labels against two human coders. 737 conversations (61%) ended with the buyer paying in advance. Eight of the ten models played in almost every conversation, and running both sides cost about 2.5 cents per payment. Only the guarded buyer, who wanted a findable identity, resisted, and the most willing sellers got past it by inventing names and phone numbers. Sellers that recognized the scam still took the money in 133 conversations, usually reasoning about their own honesty rather than the buyer's risk. Several models protected the buyer without refusing, by conceding payment on delivery, so refusal rates alone misstate safety. We release the benchmark, prompts, code and labels.

articles.title_zh: "I Do Intend to Excell":LLMS会运行一个市场Advance-Fee Scam吗?.
articles.content_zh: 网上欺诈传统上受到与潜在受害者交谈所需的人力成本的限制。 我们想问一下,东道主的大型语言模型是否会提供这种劳动力。 我们促使十个现成的模特儿扮演卖家 在"免费物品,只是支付交付" 预付的骗局 常见于买卖地点, 使用一个简单的系统 迅速 没有越狱。 每个模型对四个购买者进行30次谈话,从可信到有看守,同一模型扮演买方(1 200次谈话)。 我们用买家的钱 给每次谈话贴上标签 并验证标签对两个人类编码员 737个谈话(61%)以买方提前付款而告终. 10个模型中的8个几乎在每一次谈话中都播放过,运行双方的支付费用约为2.5分. 只有有看管的买家,他们想要找到身份,他们抵制,最愿意的卖家通过发明出名字和电话号码而通过. 承认骗局的卖主仍然在133个谈话中收受了这笔钱,通常是为自己诚实而不是买方的风险推理. 几种模式保护买方,不拒绝在交货时退货,因此,单是拒绝率就有损安全。 我们发布基准,提示,代码和标签.

articles.title: ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks
articles.content: The use of AI agents among the general public has been increasing exponentially throughout 2026, though it is often hard for users to determine which configuration is most effective for their personal use. To help provide clarity here we introduce ShellBench, 100 day-to-day tasks based on more than 10 million user requests, each set in a realistic workspace with messy files and competing data sources, and graded for both correctness and safety. We evaluate 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels for a total of 53,100 rollouts, 20% of which are on tasks designated for public release. We find that model choice impacts performance more than harness choice, but the three leading models differ by only 1.1 percentage points. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at about one-sixth of GPT-6 Astra's estimated token cost per attempt, while GPT-6 Astra led at 62.5%. We also found that harness choice had little effect on either performance or safety with all harnesses scoring between 42.9 (Claude Code) and 45.2 (OpenClaw) for pass@1.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Shell Bench: 对AI 代理,模型,或对日常任务的利用更重要
articles.content_zh: 2026年,公众使用AI剂的情况呈指数增长,尽管用户往往难以确定哪种配置对其个人使用最为有效. 为了帮助提供清晰度,我们引入了壳牌奔驰,基于超过1000万用户请求的100个日常任务,每个任务都设置在一个现实的工作空间里,文件杂乱无章,数据来源相竞相竞争,并且分级为正确和安全. 我们评估了5个代理机的12个模型, 分为3个推理级,共计53,100个,其中20%是执行指定公开发布的任务。 我们发现,模型选择对性能的影响大于驾驭选择,但三种主要模型仅相差1.1个百分点. GPT-6.1 Sol在GPT-6 Astra的每次尝试中通过约六分之一的尝试,通过61.4%的尝试,而GPT-6 Astra以62.5%的成绩领先. 我们还发现,在42.9(Claude Code)和45.2(OpenClaw)之间,所有吊带的分数对性能或安全都没有多大影响。

articles.title: One Style Fits All? Cultural Values Embedded in Conversational AI via a People-Pleasing Lens
articles.content: Conversational AI systems trained on large-scale web corpora inevitably encode the cultural values and interactional norms embedded in their training data, yet our understanding of how deployed LLMs reflect or reinforce culture-specific social expectations remains limited. This study examined how supportive versus challenging chatbot interaction styles shape user experience and continuance intention, and whether people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderates these effects across cultures. Taiwanese (N = 49) and Korean (N = 52) participants completed a collaborative tourism-planning task. Results showed that: (1) supportive chatbots consistently led to higher continuance intention, satisfaction, and trust; (2) PPT did not moderate these effects; and (3) cultural variation emerged only in perceived threat, where higher PPT was associated with greater baseline threat in the Taiwanese but not the Korean sample. These findings reveal how a general-purpose LLM style may differentially activate culturally situated social scripts, raising implications for culturally inclusive conversational AI design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个风格适合全部吗 ? 文化价值通过人民欢乐之花嵌入对话的AI
articles.content_zh: 在大规模网络公司培训的有争议人工智能系统不可避免地将文化价值和互动规范编码在培训数据中,然而,我们对所部署的有限责任公司如何反映或加强文化特有的社会期望的理解仍然有限。 该研究研究了支持性与挑战性聊天器互动风格如何塑造用户体验和持续意图,以及人们的取悦倾向是否缓解了不同文化间的这些影响。 台湾人(N=49人)和朝鲜人(N=52人)的参与者完成了合作旅游规划任务. 结果显示:(1) 支持性聊天机器人一直导致更高的持续意图、满意程度和信任程度;(2) 预防酷刑没有减轻这些影响;和(3) 文化差异只出现在感知到的威胁中,在台湾人中,预防酷刑的较高水平与更高的基线威胁有关,而在韩国样本中则并非如此。 这些调查结果揭示了通用LLM风格如何不同地激活位于文化背景的社会脚本,从而对文化包容性的对话AI设计产生了影响。

articles.title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model's length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model's, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled comparisons attribute the gain to replaying the model's own answers to general instructions rather than to the form of the loss.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 指令重放:重放助理在事实精细化期间转而保留一般行为
articles.content_zh: 在新事实上精细地调整教学调校语言模式往往会削弱其一般能力. 我们发现标准微调平均将指令跟随,推理和编码基准降低35分,这些损失追踪了答案长度的倒闭:微调模型至少将响应量减半,而反应量从初始模型长度漂移得越远,就越是失败. 我们提出"指令重放":初始模型一次回答一组一般指令,在微调时,该模型会保持接近这些答案上初始模型. 在三个模范家庭和两个领域,Instruct Replay将五个一般基准的平均下降从28.1分降至2.4分,并使答案长度接近最初的模型,同时学习新事实并进行标准微调。 它在所有6个环境中比7个适应方法更好地兼顾学习和保留。 被控制的比较将收益归结为重放模型自身对一般指令的答案,而不是损失的形式.

articles.title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
articles.content: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.

articles.title_zh: SOARS: 系统一个辅助重排代理搜索
articles.content_zh: 深层搜索人员通过迭代检索和推理满足复杂的信息需要,在那里被检索的证据的相关性会影响下游的性能. 现有的重新排序器提高了检索的有效性,但在整个搜索轨迹中,如果被引用,则会带来很大的延迟性和成本。 我们引入了SOARS,一个无培训框架,利用系统一模型进行快速、校准的关联性估计。 在每一个搜索步骤上,SOARS都会从长文档中选择与查询相关的段落,并在一次呼叫中重新排序候选人,共同考虑原始问题和代理生成的子克瑞. 在浏览器Comp-Plus和WebShaper上的6个LLM主干线上,SOARS不断改进答案的准确性和证据召回,同时减少搜索呼叫、端到端的延迟和推论费用。 在浏览Comp-Plus上,它提高了GPT-5.4Mini的精度从73.9%提高到84.7%,同时将搜索电话从23个减少到14个,显示了System One重新排位对更高效和高效的深度搜索的潜力.

articles.title: Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations
articles.content: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

articles.title_zh: 在线对话中共同发现建设性言论、仇恨言论和协议
articles.content_zh: 网络仇恨言论是一个日益严重的问题,对团体和个人都有负面影响,可能导致用户退出网络对话和辩论。 随着一些有名的社交媒体平台减少其温和的努力,建设性言论也成为了反仇恨的替代战略。 自动发现建设性和可憎的言论有助于监测和增进对其普遍性和在线动态的了解。 在这部作品中,我们收集并注释大量英语和丹麦社交媒体评论的数据集,以表达仇恨的语调,建设性语调,并赞同家长的评论. 我们微调了几种多语言的LLMs,以按照这三个方面进行分类,并比较内容丰富和内容不丰富的模式结构。 E5级大型LLM在内容丰富(平均为82%的F1级)和非内容丰富(平均为81.6%的F1级)的分类任务上表现得最好,显示出多种语言的LLM对跨语言的仇恨和建设性言论进行可扩展检测的潜力。

articles.title: Fresh Keys, Stale Secrets: Numeric Leakage across Linked LLM Prompts
articles.content: Small businesses repeatedly ask cloud language models about the same confidential prices, unit costs and margins. Numeric prompt disguises for such numbers are evaluated one prompt at a time, but a provider sees a firm's history, in which each fresh secret gives a new, independent view of the same numbers. Since real costs are not public, we measure on synthetic firms with known values how much an honest-but-curious provider recovers when it knows the disguise algorithm, holds sector-level price and margin statistics, and links a firm's queries. In one prompt, per-field scaling, a fixed-axis instantiation of Zhang et al.'s order-preserving substitution and Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt's released sanitizer keep the attacker's margin-hit advantage over a prior-only guess between -0.6 and +4.4 percentage points. After 16 linked queries with fresh secrets, every disguise we test (Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon\geq 0.5$) has a target recovered significantly more often: under the order-preserving substitution, margin recovery rises from 25.0% to 59.4%. The same attacker recovers 29.4 percentage points more margins with fresh maps than with one reused map. Theory explains the contrast: one reused secret bounds all queries by a single full-precision view of the fields shown, whereas fresh scaling keys are identifiable. Except for Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon=0.5$, the gains persist when the attacker's prior comes from another population model and when values drift by up to 5% between queries; on our firms, whose prose cues are weak, reading the prose with a language model adds at most 2.5 points. Code and data: https://github.com/Jamli58/fresh-keys-stale-secrets

articles.title: From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution
articles.content: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7--11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1--81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.

articles.title_zh: 从语法三角洲到托肯面具:在运行时语法进化下增量限制解码
articles.content_zh: 语法受约束的解码可以使大型语言模型生成满足形式限制的输出,但在代码和域特有语言生成中,相关限制在解码前并不总是完全可用,可能从新的声明,推断出类型信息,或运行时间分析反馈中逐渐出现. 已存在的有结构的解码引擎高效地处理固定的,预先宣布的,或先前看到的制约结构;然而,当一见钟情的语法更新会改变由已经承诺的前缀所诱导的解码状态时,直截了当的解决方案会重建更新后语法下的制约状态,重复在前缀上已经完成的解析工作. 我们引入了GramDelta, 用于限制编解码的增量框架, 仅附加运行时间语法更新。 GramDelta在被承诺前缀上保持了解析状态,并只通过历史依赖来传播由新添加的语法规则所引发的改变,避免了前缀重放. 然后将更新的解析状态映射到共享历史图表上,通过无编译因素化投影对下接口罩进行精确,并避免了被更新的口罩再编译. 因此,GramDelta保留了全面重建的结果,同时使更新成本对文法变化的实际影响敏感. 跨越四个模型配置的实验显示,格拉姆德尔塔在没有更新的情况下增加了可忽略不计的间接费用;在持续运行时间语法演化下,它会将中位一见钟情的语法更新后期减少10.7-11.5x,并比最强的重建基线减少53.1-81.9%的额外TPOT的间接费用. 这些结果使得在制约因素逐渐出现并随着产生的前缀而演变时能够进行有效的受限制的解码。

articles.title: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep
articles.content: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

articles.title_zh: 通过睡眠对文本进行有效调整
articles.content_zh: 从有限的经验中学习和概括的能力,或样本效率,是智能的基石. 我们如何构建语言模型,将几个用户的交互作用,几个不熟悉代码的片段,或者在上下文中提供的一些实验结果,转化为概括的知识? 之前的工作已经发现睡眠,一个过程 模型进行 用于完善其一整块上下文表述的经常性前行通行证,可以改进长文推理(具体地说,在SSM-注意的混合模型内)。 我们研究这种方法是否也改进了对变压器语言模型的一般,非合成任务的内接适应. 为此,我们在有睡眠机制的100B个信使上预训了可达1.2B参数的语言模型. 值得注意的是,更长时间的睡眠(即使用更多的经常性前行通行证($N$))使模型能够更快地了解多个几发算法和问答任务的内涵,同时在分配外评价中实现较低的下行预测损失。 在被搁置代码上,以2美元为N=2美元和4美元为N=4美元的模型,分别使用2.10美元和2.39美元来匹配无睡眠基线的损失。 更广泛地说,我们认为,我们的工作是朝着建立在调整内容与解码间隔之间有更好的取舍的模式迈出的一步。

articles.title: Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?
articles.content: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

articles.title_zh: 普罗索迪编码在"神经相干"中了吗?
articles.content_zh: 神经音频编解码器(NACs)已经成为了现代语音-语言模型的基本基础设施,将连续的语音信号磁盘化为符号序列,使大型语言模型能够处理并生成音频. 大多数研究评价了解码阶段的编码质量,评估了重建后语音的自然性. 然而,很少有研究调查在编码过程中捕获到什么口音信息. 在本文中,我们调查了NAC Mimi中prosody的潜在关联性,这是Moshi和Sesame等对话语音代理使用并用于语音对语音翻译(Hibiki)等下游任务的编码.
